«Esas ideas son muy hermosas en teoría pero no son practicables; los nombres necesitan un poder ponderador que los gobierne y obligue a respetar el contrato social». Esa es la última objeción que nos dirigen los partidarios del actual orden social cuando, después de haber discutido, se han quedado sin argumentos y demostrado que el trabajador no puede esperar ninguna mejora sensible para su suerte conservando los mecanismos del actual sistema social.

«Esas ideas son muy hermosas, pero no son practicables; el hombre no está bastante desarrollado para vivir en estado tan ideal. Para ponerlas en práctica sería necesario que el hombre hubiera llegado a la perfección», añaden muchas personas sinceras, pero que, extraviadas por la evolución y la rutina, no ven más que las dificultades y no están bastante convencidos de la idea de trabajar por su realización.

Además, al lado de esos adversarios declarados y de los indiferentes que pueden convertirse en amigos, surge una tercera categoría de individuos, más peligrosos que los adversarios declarados. Esos se fingen entusiastas por las ideas; declaran en alta voz que no hay nada más hermoso; que nada vale la organización actual, que debe desaparecer ante las ideas nuevas, que son el fin al cual debe tender la humanidad, etc., etc. Pero añaden que no son practicables ahora; hay que preparar para ella á la humanidad, guiarla á comprender ese estado dichoso, y con pretexto de ser prácticos, tratan de rejuvenecer esos proyectos de reformas que acabamos de demostrar que son ilusorias; perpetúan las preocupaciones actuales, lisonjeándolas en aquellos á quienes se dirigen, y tratan de sacar el partido mayor posible de la situación actual en beneficio personal, y pronto desaparece el ideal para que lo sustituya un instinto de conservación del actual orden de cosas.

Desgraciadamente, es demasiada verdad que las ideas, objeto de nuestras aspiraciones, no son realizables inmediatamente. Es demasiado ínfima la minoría que las ha comprendido para que tengan influencia inmediata en los acontecimientos y marcha de la organización social. Pero eso no es una razón para no trabajar por realizarla.

Si estamos convencidos de que son justas, debemos tratar de llevarlas á la práctica. Si todo el mundo dice que no son posibles, y acepta pasivamente el yugo de la sociedad actual, es evidente que el orden burgués durará todavía largos siglos. Si los primeros pensadores que lucharon contra la iglesia y la monarquía, por las ideas naturales y por la independencia, y afrontaron la hoguera y el patíbulo, para confesarlas hubieran pensado así, todavía estaríamos en los tiempos de los conceptos místicos y los derechos feudales.

Gracias á que siempre hubo gente que no era práctica, pero que estaba convencida de la verdad, y trataron de hacerla penetrar con todas sus fuerzas por donde pudieron, empezando el hombre á conocer su origen y á deshacerse de las preocupaciones de autoridad divina y humana.
En su libro que realmente vale, Bosquejo de una moral sin obligación ni sanción, desarrolla Guyau, en un capítulo admirable, la siguiente idea: «El que no obra como piensa, no piensa por completo». Es verdad. El que está bien convencido de una idea no puede menos de propagarla y de tratar de realizarla.

Muchas disputas se presencian entre amigos por …

title: Se realiza este miércoles una jornada federal en defensa de la ciencia argentina
content:
La jornada federal en defensa de la ciencia, la tecnología y la universidad pública, se llevará a cabo este miércoles 12 de agosto de 2026 a partir de las 16:00 horas. La convocatoria principal tendrá lugar en el Obelisco de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires, acompañada de manifestaciones en las plazas más importantes de todo el país.


Bajo el lema colectivo “Ponete la camiseta”, los organizadores invitan a los asistentes a concurrir vistiendo camisetas o portando banderas argentinas como símbolo de respaldo al sector estratégico nacional.


Trabajadores y trabajadoras de la ciencia denuncian el desfinanciamiento sostenido y la paralización de proyectos de investigación esenciales. Además, informes sectoriales alertan sobre la destrucción de aproximadamente 6.400 puestos de trabajo en el ámbito científico-tecnológico.


También exigen una prórroga para cerca de 400 becarios posdoctorales del CONICET que finalizaron sus contratos en julio, y reclaman mejoras salariales urgentes para todo el personal y la efectivización de los cargos pendientes.


Fuente:

https://agencia.farco.org.ar/2026/08/10/jornada-federal-en-defensa-de-la-ciencia-argentina/

author: CMI Argentina
title: Acto en el Hospital Italiano por la reincorporación de César Latorre
content:
El 19 de junio pasado, la Justicia Laboral ordenó la reinstalación en un plazo máximo de cinco días de César Latorre en el Hospital Italiano de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires, donde fue echado sin causa en un acto persecutorio. Pero la patronal se niega ilegalmente a cumplir la medida.


En abril,

la patronal del Hospital Italiano de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires echó sin causa a César Latorre

, quien fue delegado general de la Comisión Interna de dicho nosocomio hasta el año 2024. Aprovechando que ya no tenía fueros, y ante la proximidad de nuevas elecciones de delegados, la empresa avanzó contra un referente histórico de los trabajadores del hospital.


Sin embargo, la Justicia Laboral dictó una medida cautelar para ser cumplida en el plazo máximo de 5 días,ordenando a las autoridades del Hospital Italiano a reinstalar a César Latorre en su puesto de trabajo. Dicho plazo se cumplió el 26 de junio, pero la empresa lo desconoce, colocándose en la ilegalidad.


“Es grave. El fallo es claro y contundente: lo despidieron con un procedimiento inusual, con legajo impecable, por ser delegado y reclamar derechos de los trabajadores. La propia Justicia lo llamó despido ‘con finalidad aleccionadora’. No hay lugar a más maniobras”, plantearon desde la Agrupación Bordó Sanidad.


En este contexto, se realizará un acto este miércoles 12 de agosto a las 13hs en Perón 4190 para exigir la reinstalación de César Latorre.

author: CMI Argentina
title: Operativo represivo del 6 de agosto: Monteoliva no sabe, pero contesta
content:
Cuatro días después de la represión en el Congreso, la ministra de Seguridad Alejandra Monteoliva salió a dar explicaciones. Pero sus declaraciones evidenciaron más desconocimiento que certezas: confundió el rango de un comisario inspector, justificó la presencia de efectivos de civil sin identificación visible y definió como “escopeta de ruido” un arma que el manual de la PFA describe como letal. Las imágenes muestran a un comisario de alto rango portando una Ithaca de culata corta, granadas lanzadas en horizontal y un proyectil dentro de un local cerrado que afectó a una empleada. ¿Desconocimiento o complicidad? Confrontamos sus dichos con los manuales de la fuerza y las normas internacionales que el gobierno viola sistemáticamente.


Disparo horizontal de lanzagranadas de gas por efectivos de la PFA el 6 de agosto de 2026.

Foto: Nicolas Solo ((i))


Este lunes, la ministra de Seguridad Alejandra Monteoliva se refirió a los hechos ocurridos el día jueves en Plaza Congreso. En el marco de la sesión de Senadores donde se votaba el proyecto de ley de extranjerización de tierras, modificación a la ley del fuego, la creación de un supuesto de desalojo exprés entre otros puntos regresivos, se desató cerca de las 17 hs una fuerte represión para desalojar la Plaza Congreso donde se expresaba una multitudinaria manifestación. Con la idea de llegar a la votación sin presión en la calle las fuerzas de seguridad federales avanzaron sobre la ciudadanía, para luego dejar en la Policía de la Ciudad la continuidad del operativo.


Entre algunos de los eventos, se advirtió de un hecho particular en el que se vio a una persona de civil con una Ithaca 37, sin culata, a cargo de un grupo de la Policía Federal Argentina (PFA) de civil y camperas azules identificatorias. El mismo fue identificado como comisario inspector Gustavo Antonio Gauna.


El comisario Gustavo Antonio Gauna reprimiendo en la marcha contra la ley de extranjerización de tierras. Foto: Kaloian Santos


Pasado 4 días el Ministerio de Seguridad Nacional no emite comunicación alguna, recién el día lunes la ministra de Seguridad Alejandra Monteoliva se refirió a los hechos, al ser entrevistada en un evento en la Bolsa de Comercio de Córdoba, dejando las siguientes afirmaciones:


“La información que tengo sobre este caso, sí, es un agente de Policía Federal. Es un oficial… un oficial jefe.


La gente de Investigaciones está de civil, tienen una camperita con el logo de la fuerza y deben colgar la placa, ¿sí? Generalmente, el jefe de esas divisiones de Investigaciones están de civil con su placa. ¿Sí? Es probable que en este caso este comisario —no sé si es comisario o subcomisario, no lo tengo claro— que eh… es el oficial de turno en ese día haya tenido su placa colgada, como lo tienen… vestido de traje con la placa. Frente al uso del arma, por la foto que vi —podés corregir, Juan Pablo, que… con más ojo— es una escopeta de …la de ruido. Eh… con perdi… perdigones de… de estruendo. Eso quería decir, estruendo. ¿Qué cosa sale de un… un perdigón de estruendo? Ruido. Es de estruendo”.


https://argentina.indymedia.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Alejandra-Monteoliva-Bolsa-de-Comercio-de-Cordoba.mp4


Declaraciones de Alejandra Monteoliva en Córdoba. Video: La Tinta.


La ministra de Seguridad en esta simple declaración demostró el desconocimiento que tiene de la organización de una de las fuerzas de seguridad que comanda.


En primer lugar, desconoce (o finge desconocer) un funcionario de alto rango en su cartera y el funcionamiento del área de Investigaciones.


Dentro del escalafón de oficiales de PFA comisario inspector pertenece a la plana mayor de la organización, por encima se encuentra Comisario Mayor y Comisario General, por lo que el Gauna no es un desconocido, ni es un ascenso más, sino que está en carrera para acceder a la conducción de la fuerza.


Seguidamente, indica que el procedimiento de Investigaciones es aplicable a un protocolo de evento masivo de prevención y seguridad.


Pero parece no haberle alcanzado lo primero, deja claro que desconoce el armamento que ella misma autoriza comprar y usar.


En primer lugar, la guía de autoridades 2025 de la PFA establece el nombramiento del mismo:


En parte de su declaración indicó “en un operativo la gente de investigaciones está de civil, tienen una campera con el logo de la fuerza y deben colgarse la placa”, sobre esto hay que recalcar, el personal policial cuando realiza estas tareas porta identificación, no …

title: Docentes de Tierra del Fuego llevan nueve días de paro por un Salario Mínimo Vital de $3 millones acorde a la Constitución
content:
El Sindicato Unificado de Trabajadoras y Trabajadores de la Educación Fueguina (SUTEF) mantiene un paro por tiempo indeterminado que comenzó el lunes 3 de agosto y ya lleva nueve días consecutivos, con un acatamiento superior al 80% en toda la provincia. La medida de fuerza de docentes, que impidió el inicio del segundo semestre escolar, exige que el salario docente alcance los $3.000.352 que establece la Constitución Nacional para el Salario Mínimo Vital y Móvil. Desde el Frente de Sindicatos Unidos (FreSU Federal) manifestaron su “profundo apoyo y solidaridad” con el reclamo.

La huelga docente en Tierra del Fuego ingresó en su segunda semana y se profundiza el conflicto. El Sindicato Unificado de Trabajadoras y Trabajadores de la Educación Fueguina (SUTEF) reclama además el cese de los descuentos que califica como “persecutorios”, un plan de desendeudamiento familiar y el tratamiento de un proyecto de Ley de Financiamiento Educativo presentado hace dos años en la Legislatura provincial. Las movilizaciones se replican en Ushuaia, Río Grande y Tolhuin, con acampes frente a la Casa de Gobierno y permanencias en el Ministerio de Educación.


El Secretario General del SUTEF, Horacio Catena, llamó a profundizar la unidad sindical y advirtió que “esto no da para más”. “No alcanza con un comunicado, un tuit; acá la población se tiene que movilizar completa”, sostuvo, y reclamó la conformación de un comité provincial de crisis para abordar la situación económica y laboral que atraviesa la provincia. Ayer mismo,

el Grupo Mirgor de la familia Caputo despidió a 300 obreros metalúrgicos

 en la ciudad fueguina de Río Grande, incluyendo a 28 delegados.


Desde el Frente de Sindicatos Unidos (FreSU Federal) manifestaron su “profundo apoyo y solidaridad” con la medida de fuerza y destacaron el ejemplo de “valentía” de los docentes fueguinos al iniciar una huelga por tiempo indeterminado para luchar por el Salario Mínimo Vital y Móvil según su definición constitucional y legal, tal cual lo reivindican históricamente los Aceiteros y que asumió como propio el FreSU.


Según el artículo 14 bis de la Constitución Nacional y el artículo 116 de la Ley de Contrato de Trabajo, el Salario Mínimo Vital y Móvil debe asegurar a los trabajadores sin carga de familia, en su jornada legal de trabajo, la satisfacción de las 9 necesidades: alimentación adecuada, vivienda digna, educación, vestuario, asistencia sanitaria, transporte, esparcimiento, vacaciones y previsión. El valor actual del mismo es de $3.000.352, según los cálculos del Mirador de la Actualidad del Trabajo y la Economía (MATE) encabezado por Sergio Arelovich, asesores económicos de Aceiteros y el FreSU, actualizado a julio de 2026.


 


Ver esta publicación en Instagram


 


Una publicación compartida por Frente de Sindicatos Unidos (FreSU) Federal (@fresufederal)


El FreSU exige al gobierno de Gustavo Melella, a los intendentes y a los legisladores provinciales que respondan al reclamo por la Ley de Financiamiento Educativo y por el Salario Mínimo Vital y Móvil.


El gobernador Melella convocó a los representantes gremiales el mismo lunes en que el paro ya estaba en marcha, pero el encuentro no produjo un acuerdo. El gobierno provincial, aseguran, enfrenta una situación fiscal crítica: la masa salarial docente representa el 66% de los ingresos por coparticipación y el distrito es uno de los más afectados por el ajuste nacional, con un déficit mensual blanqueado de $27.000 millones. El ministro de Educación, Pablo López Silva, afirmó que el margen de maniobra es “casi nulo”.


Este martes, se realizaron acampes y protestas ante la Casa de Gobierno en Ushuaia, la Delegación del Ministerio de Educación en Tolhuin y la sede del Ministerio de Educación en Río Grande.


“Exigimos al Gobierno de Melella la devolución inmediata de lo descontado, aumento salarial y una respuesta concreta a la realidad que vivimos en los jardines, escuelas, colegios y profesorados” …

author: Chris Walker
title: Amid Measles Outbreak, Trump Signs Order Furthering Anti-Vaccine Movement
content:
“Nothing bad can happen from what we’re doing,” Trump claimed, ignoring warnings from health experts.

Support justice-driven, accurate and transparent news — make a quick donation to Truthout today!

President Donald Trump has signed a new executive order on childhood vaccines, alarming multiple health experts and medical organizations due to the changes having no scientific basis.

The order, titled the “Delivering Gold Standard Childhood Vaccine Recommendations for Americans,” was signed by Trump in the Oval Office on Monday. It calls for revising vaccine recommendations for children, most notably by separating multiple combined vaccines, including for measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR).

The MMR vaccine “should be administered in three separate single-disease shots once such products are domestically available,” the order recommends. In addition to the MMR vaccine, the order also calls for “all childhood immunizations [to] be administered at separate medical visits.”

Trump claims in his order that changes are being made “based on consultation with my advisors and review of available scientific evidence.” However, the order does not explain what that evidence is, and the current scientific understanding of vaccines suggests that combining some with others is not only safe, but highly beneficial, as it results in fewer visits to the doctor’s office for vaccines and lessens the likelihood of some vaccine doses slipping through the cracks.

Separating the MMR vaccine, for example, would result in many more needless visits to the doctor. Currently, the MMR regimen requires two doses of the combined shot to be highly effective. Separating the three vaccines within the shot would therefore require six trips to the doctor, rather than the normal two (though the executive order cuts that number in half, without explaining how or why).

In comments to reporters at the signing ceremony for the executive order, Trump said he was motivated in part by concerns about vaccines supposedly being connected to autism, despite dozens of studies across decades of research finding no causal link between the two.

“I came [into office] and I said, ‘I want to find what’s going on with autism,'” Trump said. “It’s many, many times what it used to be, years ago, and it gets progressively worse as we add more and more vaccines.”

Trump’s claim that autism gets “progressively worse” as more vaccines are administered to a person has no scientific backing.

"Vats of vaccine are currently pumped into your child's body" — Trump from the Oval Office is pushing debunked claims about vaccines and autism being linked

Despite the strong possibility that changes to the vaccine schedule, including separating combined shots, could lead to fewer inoculations, Trump maintained that his actions wouldn’t have any negative consequences.

“Nothing bad can happen from what we’re doing,” he said.

The falsehoods and misleading statements from the White House extended to social media shortly after the signing ceremony. Celebrating the order, Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt shared a graphic to her X account, purporting that “European Countries” only give their infants 11 “injections,” while in the U.S., infants currently receive 72 “injections.” “No longer!” Leavitt wrote in her post.

Ironically, the order Trump signed could expand the number of “injections” an infant will receive, if the new recommendations are followed, since it separates combined vaccines. The image Leavitt shared has been fact-checked before, with AFP noting that it “misleads by implying a child will receive 72 injections in infancy,” when, in reality, those shots are administered from ages 0 to 18.

“The number of shots varies, but according to the Yale School of Public Health, the actual number is generally lower as combination and oral vaccines are administered,” that fact check noted.

Additionally, the graphic compares two different standards. While calling the shots administered “injections,” on the European side of the graphic, the number cited on that side counts the total shots recommended within an unnamed country. Conversely, on the U.S. side of the graphic, it counts each vaccination — even those combined with others — as separate shots (e.g., the MMR vaccine would be counted as six separate “injections”). Indeed, using the same metrics and flawed definitions, several European countries also advise the administration of dozens of “injections,” too, much like in the U.S.

title: Kolombiya'daki depremde ölenlerin sayısı 234'e yükseldi
content:
Kolombiya Başkentler Birliğinden (Asocapitales) ülkeyi vuran 7,4 büyüklüğündeki depremin ardından son duruma ilişkin açıklama yapıldı.

Açıklamaya göre, depremde hayatını kaybedenlerin sayısı 234'e yükseldi, 1310'dan fazla kişi yaralandı.

Ulusal basına göre, depremde en fazla can ve mal kaybının olduğu Pereira, Cali, Quibdo, Manizales ve Armenia kentlerinde kırmızı alarm ilan edildi ve güvenlik gerekçesiyle sokağa çıkma yasağı uygulamaya konuldu.

2 bin 700 kişi için kayıp başvurusunda bulunulurken, can kaybının daha da artmasından endişe ediliyor.

Ülkenin üçüncü büyük kenti Cali'de deprem nedeniyle bazı yolların çöktüğü ve 10 hastanenin hizmet veremediği bildirilirken, başkent Bogota ile Medellin'den arama kurtarma ekipleri bölgeye destek için sevk edildi.

Quibdo ve Manizales'te ise deprem, su, elektrik, telekomünikasyon ve ulaşım hizmetlerinde kesintilere neden oldu.

Kolombiya Jeoloji Hizmetleri de büyük depremin ardından 70'ten fazla artçının kaydedildiğini bildirdi.

Artçıların en büyüğünün 4,8 şiddetinde olduğu aktarıldı.

Cali Belediye Başkanı Alejandro Eder, basına yaptığı açıklamada, güvenlik ve yağma olaylarını önlemek amacıyla sokağa çıkma yasağı ilan edildiğini, kararın acil durum ve kurtarma ekiplerinin çalışmalarını daha güvenli ve hızlı yürütmesini sağlamak için alındığını söyledi.

ABD Jeolojik Araştırmalar Merkezi (USGS), depremin merkez üssünün Kolombiya'nın batısındaki San Jose del Palmar kasabasının yaklaşık 5 kilometre doğusu olduğunu ve depremin 7,4 büyüklüğünde meydana geldiğini açıklamıştı.

Deprem, Kolombiya'nın yanı sıra Venezuela, Ekvador ve Panama'nın çeşitli bölgelerinde de hissedilmişti.

Merkezi Venezuela'da bulunan Telesur internet sitesinin haberine göre, Kolombiya'daki deprem nedeniyle Venezuela'da bazı binaların dış cepheleri kısmen yıkılmış, bir katedral ve bir havalimanı hasar görmüştü.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Nehaa Bimal
title: Auditor general plans to review Nunavut’s drinking water management
content:
The Office of the Auditor General of Canada is planning to examine how drinking water is managed in Nunavut, amid years of problems with the territory’s water infrastructure.


The audit is expected to be released in 2027, but its scope, methodology and timeline have not yet been finalized, wrote Vincent Frignon, a spokesperson for the auditor general’s office, in an email.


The review comes as Nunavut continues to face challenges maintaining reliable access to safe drinking water. 


A 2024 report by Nunatsiaq News

 found that only eight of the territory’s 25 water treatment plants passed their most recent public health inspections without health or safety deficiencies. The other 17 had issues ranging from chlorine management and testing problems to inadequate operator training.


Five communities had no certified water-treatment operators at the time of those inspections, while Naujaat, Coral Harbour and Baker Lake were under public health orders to address deficiencies.


In addition,

Gjoa Haven experienced a nearly seven-month boil-water advisory

this year

 after a break was

discovered

 in January along the six-kilometre water main that connects Swan Lake to the community’s treatment plant. 


Kugaaruk’s water-treatment plant was

disabled

 in December 2025 after seawater entered the system during an unusually high tide last December, prompting military assistance.


Pangnirtung

declared

 a state of emergency in September 2025 after its water treatment plant stopped producing water. 


The City of Iqaluit

declared

 a state of emergency in late 2021 after fuel was

detected

 in its water supply. The problem arose again in January 2022. Ultimately it would take

18 months

 for the city’s water plant to come back online in April 2023.


People in Sanikiluaq

haven’t been able to drink

 their municipal water since 2016 because of salinity concerns.


Boil water advisories remained in place as of Tuesday in Igloolik, Pond Inlet and Arctic Bay.


Back in Iqaluit, the city announced an emergency water shutdown in the Plateau area on Tuesday because of an unspecified urgent infrastructure issue, which has also triggered a precautionary boil-water advisory for affected residents.


The territory’s 2023 Drinking Water Strategic Framework estimated that addressing its water-treatment infrastructure deficit would cost $605 million.


The document also called for updated drinking-water regulations, more training for water plant operators and a certification board.

author: Sharon Zhang
title: ICE Stationed Undercover Agent Outside of Ilhan Omar Town Hall Meeting, She Says
content:
The incident happened just days before Minnesota’s primary election.

Truthout is an indispensable resource for activists, movement leaders and workers everywhere. Please make this work possible with a quick donation.

Rep. Ilhan Omar (D-Minnesota) is demanding answers from the Trump administration after she discovered that an undercover ICE agent was stationed outside of one of her town hall meetings, raising fears of intimidation by the agency just days before the state’s primary election.

Last Thursday, local law enforcement who were coordinating security for the event in Richfield, Minnesota, noticed that there was a woman parked outside of the building in a suspicious vehicle, as attendees were entering, Omar said on Friday. A police officer ran the plates for the vehicle and found out that the records didn’t match the vehicle, and asked her about why she was there.

The woman initially claimed to be a security officer, but Omar’s team said that she was not involved with their security for the event. It was then that she called her supervisor and admitted that she was an agent of Homeland Security Investigations (HSI), a law enforcement agency within Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). She left after speaking with her supervisor, Omar says.

The agent claimed that she was there as part of an undercover drug enforcement operation, though local law enforcement said they received no advance notice of such an operation from HSI. Omar raised doubts about this claim, saying that the event was clearly labelled with a “prominent sign” for the meeting and that a reasonable person would assess that it would not be an ideal place for a drug operation.

In a letter to HSI first reported by HuffPost, Omar also raised concerns about the use of ICE agents as an intimidation tactic, especially against the Trump administration’s political opponents and especially after agents’ violent raid of Minneapolis in Operation Metro Surge earlier this year. She demanded that HSI answer questions on the reasoning for the agent’s presence outside of the event and whether or not HSI is stationing agents with relation to her activities in particular.

The lawmaker also pointed out that she received assurances from Department of Homeland Security (DHS) officials when she met with them in March that they were no longer switching license plates on their vehicles, which is against the law. However, this practice appears to be continuing, as evidenced by the incident on Thursday.

“HSI’s actions yesterday evening put an entire community at risk,” Omar wrote.

“It also raises serious and uncomfortable questions about the purpose of HSI’s presence outside of my event,” she went on. “At best, your agent was unable to assess that the parking lot of a community center hosting a Congressional event wasn’t the best place to conduct a drug operation. At worst, it emphasizes many Americans’ growing concern that the Trump administration uses ICE to surveil political opponents and may interfere with our democracy.”

Omar has repeatedly faced racist direct attacks from President Donald Trump, and, amid the ICE raids in January, was assaulted by a Trump supporter with a syringe full of vinegar while she was holding a town hall.

The latest incident occurred just days before Tuesday’s primary election in Minnesota, in which Omar is up for election and is expected to win.

However, civil liberties advocates have raised concerns about the Trump administration’s threats to deploy ICE agents to polling places as a form of intimidation and voter suppression — particularly against immigrants and non-white people who have been targeted in ICE’s raids and mass deportation campaign.

author: Adam Mahoney
title: As Foodborne Illnesses Surge, People Turn to Local Farms for Certainty
content:
Black farmers see a rise in support as cyclospora and salmonella outbreaks drive concerns over industrial food systems.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

This summer, it has felt like the flow of Black folks and families arriving at Deep Roots CPS Farm in Charlotte, North Carolina, has never let up, said Cherie Jzar, the farm’s managing director.

They’re in search of something that has become harder to find in the grocery aisle: certainty.

They’re asking about lettuce — when and where you can best grow it — and how they can incorporate other vegetables like tomatoes, cucumbers, and leafy greens into their diets.

Increasingly, Jzar has noted, they’re asking because they are worried about cyclospora, the parasite at the center of a sprawling national foodborne-illness outbreak tied in part to iceberg lettuce grown in central Mexico.

Since June, the federal government has noted more than 22,000 cases in 47 states, over 500 hospitalizations, and at least two deaths related to the parasite.

“They are coming to us wanting to purchase from a trusted source,” said Jazar, co-founder of Deep Roots CPS Farm. “They tell us straight away, like, we’re looking to purchase because we’re concerned about the parasite.”

For Black farmers, the outbreak has become a stark reminder of why their work matters. In communities where generations of Black families have been pushed off farmland and shut out of healthy-food access, farms like Deep Roots are offering a chance to rebuild a relationship to the land and the people who grow what ends up on the table.

Jazar hopes the moment will push more Black consumers to seek out and invest in Black growers — not just during a food-safety crisis, but as a way to build a more self-sustaining local food system.

Across the country, Americans are turning to local growers. Farmers markets are experiencing record attendance and subscriptions for Community Supported Agriculture (CSA) farms, where people can sign up for regularly distributed boxes of fresh produce, are on the rise.

“People need to be able to trust where their food comes from — that it’s been grown with care in a healthy manner,” Jazar said, and Black farmers are uniquely equipped to meet this moment. “Not only are they getting fresh, healthy produce, but they’re actually getting culturally relevant food, something they may not be able to get their hands on in the grocery store.”

Other Black farms, like Patrick Brown’s farm in Warren County, North Carolina, are also seeing an increase in supporters, but there are a few factors making it hard to meet the moment.

Brown said that farmers trying to meet that demand face rising expansion costs when trying to grow more, difficulty finding and training workers, and a lack of government support for small farm businesses.

“We got so many other obstacles in place that are in the way of expanding right now, not to mention a federal administration that is not supporting small-scale farmers,” he said.

The moment, he said, should encourage people not only to buy locally during a crisis, but to seek out farmers, CSAs, and food-distribution networks in their communities year-round. The Trump administration has rolled back federal support for minority-owned farms and cut programs that gave small farms hundreds of thousands in grants. Federal data shows that a majority of Black-operated farms report very low annual sales compared with all farms and are more likely to need grants.

The outbreak does not mean consumers need to abandon lettuce or leafy greens altogether. Public health experts have cautioned against treating every fresh vegetable as suspect, noting that the vast majority of produce moving through stores is not connected to the outbreak. But for people seeking a more direct connection to their food, Brown said local farms can still grow lettuce in the summer through indoor high tunnels and greenhouses.

Brown and Jazar said the outbreak should also encourage people to homestead and grow food in their yards or empty lots in their communities.

Deep Roots began formally in 2019, after Jazar and her family spent years homesteading and growing food for themselves. The regenerative farm now grows seasonal fruits and vegetables and raises laying hens and poultry. It was built, Jazar said, to serve Charlotte residents living with limited access to affordable fresh food …

title: Internal Security Forces launch investigation into attack on citizens who returned to Serêkaniyê
content:
Following a series of meetings between the Serêkaniyê Displaced Persons Committee, the Governor of Heseke, and officials of the Interim Government aimed at ensuring the safe return of forcibly displaced people, the first group of around 412 families returned to their homes in Serêkaniyê on Monday.


After arriving at their homes, the families came under attack by an armed group that had taken over the homes of the original residents. The armed men attacked some of the families and vandalized their vehicles.


According to Heseke Province Internal Security Forces Deputy Commander Mehmûd Xelîl, the purpose of those involved in the attack was to undermine security, prevent the return of forcibly displaced people and weaken efforts toward integration.


Stating that return convoys to the city of Serêkaniyê had been temporarily suspended in order to protect the safety of residents, Mehmûd Xelîl said, “The convoys will resume once the situation has stabilised and the full protection of those returning has been ensured.”


The Internal Security Forces in Heseke have launched an investigation into the acts of intimidation and attacks targeting the returning residents.


According to a security source, the Internal Security Forces have begun collecting information about the attack as part of the investigation and are working to identify those responsible.

title: Syrian court sentences Bashar al-Assad to death in absentia
content:
A Syrian court has sentenced former President Bashar al-Assad to death in absentia on charges of war crimes and crimes against humanity.


The ruling was issued as part of the first trials targeting senior figures of the former government following the civil war that began in 2011 and lasted for years.


Assad fled to Russia with his family after losing control of Damascus in December 2024. Because he was not present at the trial, the death sentence was handed down in absentia.


Syria’s transitional government also sentenced Atif Najib, who served as head of the Political Security Directorate in the southern city of Daraa during Assad’s rule, to death. Najib was present in court when the verdict was delivered.

author: Soraya Kishtwari
title: Health Secretary Took £500k From Mogul With Commercial Ties to NHS
content:
Health secretary Yvette Cooper has accepted almost £500,000 from a businessman with commercial ties to the NHS, an analysis by the

BMJ has

found.


Cooper, who was appointed to the new role by prime minister Andy Burnham on 20 July, received the donations from medical recruitment entrepreneur Peter Hearn and two of his firms.


According to her

parliamentary financial disclosures

, she received £248,619 directly from Hearn, as well as a further £220,623 over the past ten years from two companies: MPM Connect and OPD Group. 


Hearn, who died recently, held a significant stake in Odgers Berndtson, a recruitment firm that worked extensively with the NHS. 


Odgers has also acted as a recruitment partner for a number of senior NHS appointments. It headhunted former TalkTalk boss Dido Harding to oversee the controversial Test and Trace programme during the Covid-19 pandemic.


Cooper’s donations were declared and there is no suggestion that she breached parliamentary rules. But doctors and campaigners have raised concerns about the perception of a conflict of interest.


“NHS doctors are prohibited from accepting small gifts from pharmaceutical companies, such as a pen or a notepad, because of the risk of the perception of influence.” Steve Taylor of the Doctors’ Association UK told the BMJ. “Ministers responsible for the NHS should be held to at least the same standard.” 


“Political donations from individuals or companies with commercial ties to the NHS… inevitably raise questions about whose interests are being served,” said GP Emily Ball, director of the anti-privatisation group EveryDoctor.


“Mr Hearn kindly donated money to fund Yvette’s office staff, which has all been fully declared and is compliant with all the rules,” a spokesperson for Cooper told the BMJ. 


Hearn was a

 major Labour party donor

, with former health secretary

Wes Streeting also receiving more than £285,000

 from the mogul and his companies between February 2019 and February 2026.


Novara Media approached Odgers Berndtson for comment.

author: Nehaa Bimal
title: Inuit art sellers look to new markets as U.S. tariffs loom
content:
This story was updated on Tuesday, August 11, 2026, at 1:30 p.m. ET.


Inuit artist and advocate Theresie Tungilik says artists should start looking for other markets as a looming 50 per cent tariff threatens to make Canadian artwork more expensive for American buyers.


United States President Donald Trump announced July 20 that he would impose additional 50 per cent tariffs on a range of Canadian imports, with the measures scheduled to take effect Aug. 19.


“If it’s going to happen, or we feel it is coming, now is the best time appraise and sell Inuit art at its best price and maybe start looking at other countries that truly love Inuit art and do not have a tariff on it,” said Tungilik, a past president of the national non-profit Canadian Artists’ Representation.


The White House says the tariffs are intended to offset what it describes as Canada’s discriminatory treatment of American commerce.


The tariff list includes paintings, drawings, pastels, original prints and original sculptures. 


The list also includes fur products, hides and skins, as well as whalebone, horn and antlers, among other materials Inuit use.


Under the Canada-United States-Mexico Agreement, or CUSMA, Canadian cultural goods generally have had tariff-free access to the U.S.


Tungilik pointed to France, Belgium and Italy, where Inuit have previously exhibited their artwork. 


The domestic market remains strong as well, Tungilik said, as many Inuit artists sell within their communities or directly to buyers across Canada.


“But for Inuit artists who have collectors in the U.S. and art institutions, it will be a downfall,” Tungilik said.


Patricia Feheley, owner of Toronto-based Feheley Fine Arts, said the U.S. has long been an important market for Inuit art and that a 50 per cent tariff would be “prohibitive.” 


U.S. buyers have benefited from the weaker Canadian dollar, which has made buying Canadian and Inuit artwork less expensive. A tariff would negate that advantage. 


A sculpture priced at about US$1,440 (CAD$2,000), would face a US$720 duty under a 50 per cent tariff, bringing the buyer’s total cost to roughly US$2,160 (CAD$3,000), said Feheley. 


Some of her American clients have already asked to have purchases shipped before Aug. 19, she said. 


Mark London, owner of Galerie Elca London, a gallery in Knowlton, Quebec, that specializes in Inuit art,

is offering a 15 per cent discount through Aug. 14 to both American and Canadian clients to encourage them to buy before the deadline. 


“People are either going to stop buying, or they’re going to buy far less, or American collectors will just buy what is already in the United States,” London said, adding that the Inuit art market was already “diminishing” due to fewer collectors with disposable income. 


Liz Barron, director of the Indigenous Curatorial Collective and a member of the Visual Arts Alliance, said the tariffs could discourage cross-border exhibitions and cultural exchange by making it more costly for U.S. museums and galleries to acquire Canadian artwork.


For now, the Art Dealers Association of Canada has taken the issue to the federal government.


The association has reached out to Global Affairs Canada, Export Development Canada and the office of Marc Miller, the federal minister of Canadian identity and culture, asking for an

exemption for art under CUSMA and potential financial relief for artists and galleries, said executive director Mackenzie Sinclair.


Sinclair said she has yet to receive a response.


Nunatsiaq News also requested comment from the federal departments but did not receive a response by press time.


Correction:

 This story was updated to correct the location of Galerie Elca London.

author: Chris Walker
title: New Poll Shows Strong Support for Proportional Representation Among Americans
content:
Support for proportional representation appears to grow the more people understand what it is.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

A new poll demonstrates that Americans are ready for drastic changes regarding how lawmakers are selected to represent them in Washington, D.C.

The survey, produced by Fix Our House/New America/Verasight and published on Monday, was conducted between the end of June and the start of July. The poll sought to discern Americans’ views on the idea of proportional representation, finding a high level of support for the idea.

Proportional representation is a system of voting that allows constituents to select their government leadership based on which party they prefer. Voters are grouped into larger districts where multiple winners — not just one — can be selected.

Each party submits a list of candidates based on the number of seats attainable, and voters choose which party they like best. From those voter totals, parties receive a proportion of seats within the district. For example, in a 30-seat district, if Party A received 60 percent of the votes and Party B received 30 percent, A would win 18 seats, while B would win 9 seats.

Systems with proportional representation in place generally result in more parties being seated, as the idea of “spoiler” candidates is less worrisome — if 10 percent of the electorate in the example above likes Party C instead, for instance, they would still receive representation of around 3 seats, whereas voting for a Party C candidate in a single district system would net them zero seats, even if they consistently voted 10 percent across 30 separate districts, as is currently the case in the United States.

The poll found that most Americans do not have a strong grasp of what proportional representation is, even though it’s widely used around the world, including by a large number of governments that have both single district and proportional representation systems intertwined. Still, when presented with questions that help explain proportional representation, or provided with details on how it works, voters tended to support the idea.

In the question, “Do you support proportional representation for U.S. Congressional elections?” 47 percent of voters said yes, while just 21 percent said no. Expanding that question to be more detailed — asking “Do you support a system in which political parties win seats in Congress in proportion to their share of the overall vote?” — 50 percent of voters said yes, with 22 percent saying no, indicating that, the more people understand proportional representation, the more likely they are to support it.

Respondents also expressed concerns with current problems associated with single district voting, suggesting they could easily reject that model in favor of one that is more reflective of voters’ preferences. Noting that many states are drawn in gerrymandered ways — allowing political parties to redraw electoral boundaries to benefit themselves — voters were several times more likely to express disdain with the single district system.

“A party that wins 48 percent of the statewide vote could end up with 65 percent of the seats,” the poll asked respondents, referencing the outcome in state legislative races from Wisconsin in 2022 that contradicted the statewide gubernatorial race. “Does this concern you?”

Only 13 percent of respondents said they weren’t concerned by this outcome, while a whopping 76 percent said that they were, the poll found.

More than 6 in 10 respondents (61.1 percent) also said they would prefer to have “several representatives for a larger area, where you are more likely to have one who shares your views,” rather than the current model of “one representative for your local area, who may or may not share your political views.”

“The table is set for proportional representation,” an explainer of the survey from Fix Our House said. “In a moment of gerrymandering, total war, extreme polarization, and a dysfunctional Congress, the American public is eager to embrace big ideas that strike at the roots of the problem.”

While the idea of proportional representation might seem “radical” to some, the poll suggests Americans are open to such drastic reforms of government, especially at a time when true democracy is dwindling in the country. This includes a potential openness to some ideas …

author: Mosha Folger
title: Clyde River boy missing after falling from makeshift raft
content:
A boy from Clyde River is missing after apparently falling from a makeshift raft last week near the community.


Police were notified about the situation on Aug. 6 at around 8 a.m., police said Tuesday in a news release.


Two young people were floating on separate makeshift rafts near the community when the current pulled them out, the release said.


One fell into the water and did not resurface.


Neither of them were wearing a life jacket.


Police, search and rescue, and community members looked for the boy using boats, ATVs, a drone and foot patrols along the coast.


Some residents posted on social media appealing to hunters and boaters to keep an eye out for any unusual items in the water.


RCMP spokesperson Cpl. Ashley Daley wrote in an email that she can’t confirm what the rafts were made from and that the search will continue until the boy is located.

author: Clara Saliba
title: (Quase) tudo o que você precisa saber sobre o Copom e a Taxa Selic
content:
Na quarta-feira passada, o Comitê de Política Monetária (Copom) se reuniu para definir a taxa Selic e aprovou sua quarta redução consecutiva. Com menos 0,25 pontos percentuais, o novo valor é de 14% ao ano. 


Você provavelmente já viu essa notícia em algum lugar, mas sabe o que ela significa? 


O Copom é um órgão do Banco Central do Brasil (ou Bacen), composto de um presidente e oito membros, diretores de diferentes áreas do Banco.

 Os membros, assim como o presidente, são nomeados pelo Presidente da República e possuem mandatos de quatro anos, descasados entre si e do calendário de eleições presidenciais, para evitar interferências diretas do poder Executivo no andamento do Comitê. Atualmente, quem preside o Copom é o economista Gabriel Galípolo, com seis cadeiras do conselho ocupadas. 


Dentre elas, apenas uma mulher: Izabela Moreira Corrêa, e um homem negro: Ailton de Aquino Santos, a primeira pessoa negra a integrar a diretoria do Banco. 


A cada 45 dias, o Comitê se reúne para decidir a meta da taxa Selic para o próximo período. Ela é a taxa de juros referenciada pelo Banco Central, principalmente em suas operações de empréstimos para os bancos comerciais.

 Esses empréstimos são fundamentais para que os bancos que conhecemos no dia a dia, como o Itaú ou o Bradesco, consigam resolver buracos no seu saldo diário, que às vezes ocorrem pela diferença na quantidade de dinheiro que entra e sai do banco no mesmo dia. 


Selic significa Sistema Especial de Liquidação e Custódia

, e o nome tem bastante a ver com o mecanismo que o Bacen utiliza.

A taxa não é definida por um decreto, mas pela compra e venda dos títulos do governo.


Funciona assim: quando o Copom decide baixar os juros, o Banco Central compra os títulos do mercado, o que reduz o número de títulos, e aumenta a quantidade de reais em circulação.

 Esses reais, a moeda, são o que os economistas chamam do ativo mais líquido,, que recebe esse nome porque pode ser convertido em essencialmente qualquer coisa a qualquer momento. É como um líquido mesmo, que flui com facilidade de um lugar para outro. Diferente de um carro, por exemplo, que é um bem que precisa de algum tempo e algum custo para se transformar em outra coisa. 


Então, quando o Bacen troca títulos por moeda, dizemos que ele injeta “liquidez” na economia. Acontece que a taxa de juros funciona basicamente como um “preço” do dinheiro: é a recompensa que se paga por seu empréstimo. Por isso,

mais dinheiro na economia induz a uma taxa de juros mais baixa. 


É a lei da oferta e demanda, pensando no dinheiro como um bem cujo preço depende de sua abundância ou escassez.


Quando o Copom aumenta a Selic, ocorre o inverso, e o Bacen vende os títulos, tirando dinheiro de circulação e aumentando seu preço. Assim, a taxa Selic efetiva sobe novamente.


A Selic é tão importante porque ela define os juros do empréstimo mais seguro que existe, aquele feito ao próprio governo.


Quanto maior o risco de uma operação financeira, maiores os juros.

Como a Selic precifica a operação financeira mais segura, ela serve como base para o nível dos juros aplicados nas demais operações, que serão sempre maiores, pois são invariavelmente mais arriscados. 


Mas, que diferença isso faz para alguém que não está lidando com grandes operações financeiras? Toda, porque

os efeitos da taxa básica de juros reverberam por toda a economia.


Em primeiro lugar, porque quanto maior a taxa básica, maiores serão as outras taxas de juros: os juros pagos no cartão de crédito, no cheque especial, nos empréstimos e consignados e nos financiamentos, por exemplo. 


Com uma taxa básica de juros alta, todo tipo de empréstimo fica mais caro. Fica mais caro comprar nas Casas Bahia. Fica mais caro pagar a hipoteca da casa. Fica mais caro para o comerciante comprar um estoque de mercadorias através de um empréstimo. 


Em segundo, porque os juros vão influenciar o nível de atividade econômica como um todo. 


Juros mais altos desestimulam o consumo das pessoas, mas também o investimento das empresas. Você não vai trocar de carro ou financiar um imóvel porque o valor final está alto demais. Um investidor também não vai comprar uma nova planta industrial nessas condições. 


E mais: para quem tem grandes quantidades de dinheiro para aplicar, os investimentos financeiros – como a poupança ou os títulos do governo – se tornam mais atrativos do que o investimento produtivo. Com um retorno tão alto garantido, ninguém vai querer se arriscar …

author: Unknown
title: Bukan court sentences two Kurdish men to two years in prison
content:
Rahim Shilani and Azad Rasouli-Fard, two Kurdish men from Bukan, have each been sentenced to two years in prison by Branch Two of Bukan Criminal Court for “buying and selling Starlink satellite equipment”.


The Kurdistan Human Rights Network (KHRN) has reported that the two men were notified of the sentences in recent days.


Ministry of Intelligence forces arrested Shilani and Rasouli-Fard in Bukan on 30 January and transferred them to the ministry’s detention facility in Orumiyeh, the provincial capital.


They were held there for 52 days, during which they were denied access to legal counsel and family visits and subjected to physical and psychological torture.


After their interrogations ended, the two men were transferred to Bukan Prison and released on bail of 30 billion rials in mid-April.

author: Mag
title: Trumps Angriffe auf die Pressefreiheit und unabhängige Medien als „Feinde des Volkes“
content:
Dossier


„

… Von dem Moment an, als Trump ins Amt zurückkehrte, hat seine zweite Regierungsmannschaft einer Reihe von rechtsextremen Einflussnehmern und Nachrichtenagenturen Zugang und Status verschafft, darunter auch Persönlichkeiten mit zweifelhafter Vergangenheit und dünnen oder nicht vorhandenen journalistischen Referenzen. Auf diese Weise hat die Regierung einen Schwall schmeichelhafter Medienberichterstattung geschaffen, eine hauchdünne Blase um jede ihrer Entscheidungen, egal wie destruktiv oder inkohärent sie auch sein mag. Diese neuen staatlichen Medien zeigen bedingungslose Loyalität, und ihre Propaganda-Pipeline ist schneller als je zuvor und stellt sicher, dass jede Durchführungsverordnung oder jeder neue Schritt des Ministeriums für Regierungseffizienz in dem Moment, in dem er bekannt gegeben wird, mit begeisterter Pseudo-Berichterstattung begrüßt wird…“

Aus dem engl.

Artikel von Anna Merlan vom 25. Februar 2025 in Mother Jones

 

 – siehe mehr Informationen, auch zum Widerstand:


„… sind Journalisten oft die ersten, die ins Visier geraten…“: Gewerkschaften der USA Today Co. fordern den Medienkonzern auf, die Partnerschaft mit Palantir abzubrechen


„

Die Gewerkschaften – die fast 800 Beschäftigte vertreten – erklärten, die Vereinbarung gefährde die Online-Sicherheit der Leser und das Vertrauen in das Unternehmen.


Nur wenige Tage, nachdem die USA Today Co. eine neue Vereinbarung mit dem Technologieunternehmen Palantir bekannt gegeben hatte, um die Daten ihrer Nutzer zu vermarkten, fordern gewerkschaftlich organisierte Mitarbeiter im ganzen Land das Unternehmen auf, die Partnerschaft zu beenden. Einunddreißig Gewerkschaften – darunter auch solche, die Journalisten bei einigen der größten Zeitungen der USA Today Co. wie „The Indianapolis Star“, „The Arizona Republic“ und „Detroit Free Press“ vertreten – veröffentlichten am Montag eine Erklärung, in der sie darlegten, dass die Partnerschaft die Online-Sicherheit der Leser und das Vertrauen in das Unternehmen gefährde. (…)


Die USA Today Co. – früher bekannt als Gannett – gab die Vereinbarung mit Palantir erstmals am Donnerstag im Rahmen ihrer Telefonkonferenz zum Ergebnis des zweiten Quartals bekannt. Dabei erklärte CEO Mike Reed den Investoren, dass das Unternehmen die auf künstlicher Intelligenz basierenden Tools von Palantir nutzen werde, um die von seinen Kunden und Lesern erhaltenen Daten zu analysieren. Anhand dieser Analyse könne die USA Today Co. ermitteln, wie sich diese Kunden am besten durch personalisierte Werbung, Abonnementangebote und andere Maßnahmen monetarisieren lassen. Obwohl die Führungskräfte der USA Today Co. den Palantir-Deal als Chance zur Umsatzsteigerung anpriesen, wiesen die 31 Gewerkschaften auf erhebliche Risiken hin. Zusammen vertreten sie fast 800 Beschäftigte in 18 Bundesstaaten. Laut dem jüngsten Jahresbericht an die SEC beschäftigte die USA Today Co. zum 31. Dezember rund 7.500 Mitarbeiter in den USA – von denen etwa 15 % gewerkschaftlich organisiert sind.


„Wir haben erhebliche ethische Bedenken gegenüber Palantir, dessen Software für künstliche Intelligenz (KI) dazu genutzt wurde, eine flächendeckende Überwachung voranzutreiben und verschärfte Maßnahmen gegen Einwanderer zu unterstützen“, heißt es in der Erklärung der Gewerkschaften. „Die Zusammenarbeit mit Palantir, einem wichtigen Akteur in den von uns behandelten Nachrichten, führt nicht nur zu einem inhärenten Interessenkonflikt, sondern versagt auch gegenüber den Journalisten, die bei der Berichterstattung über Einwanderungskontrollen und Proteste angegriffen und zu Unrecht festgenommen wurden.“ (…)


 In der Erklärung werden zudem Bedenken geäußert, dass die Technologie von Palantir zur Überwachung und gezielten Verfolgung von Dissidenten eingesetzt werden könnte.


„Und im Laufe der Geschichte sind Journalisten oft die ersten, die ins Visier geraten“, heißt es in der Erklärung der Gewerkschaft. (…)


Die Gewerkschaften argumentierten zudem, dass Peter Thiel, Vorsitzender und Mitbegründer von Palantir, Werte vertreten habe, die im Widerspruch zu denen der USA Today Co. stünden, die sich als Medienunternehmen für die Wahrung des Ersten Verfassungszusatzes und die Förderung der Demokratie einsetzt. Thiel habe bereits zuvor erklärt, Freiheit und Demokratie seien nicht miteinander vereinbar, hieß es in der Erklärung.


Thiel trug zudem teilweise zur Schließung von Gawker bei, als er 2013 heimlich die Klage des Profi-Wrestlers Hulk Hogan gegen das Medium …

title: Spotify duyurdu: Yapay zeka profillerine 'AI Persona' etiketi gelecek
content:
Fotoğraf: Thibault Penin/Unsplash

Spotify, yapay zeka tarafından oluşturulmuş sanatçı profilleri için “AI Persona” adını verdiği yeni bir etiketi duyurdu. Bu etiket, bir sanatçı profilinde gerçek bir kişi yerine yapay zeka tarafından oluşturulmuş, insana benzeyen bir kimlik sunduğu durumlarda dinleyicilere daha fazla şeffaflık sağlamak amacıyla tasarlandı.

Eylül ortasından itibaren rozet, sanatçı profilinde (profil başlığında ve hakkında bölümünde), arama sonuçlarında ve çalma listelerindeki parça satırlarında, mobil cihazlarda görünmeye başlayacak. AI Persona olarak etiketlenen sanatçıların müzikleri, varsayılan olarak kişiselleştirilmiş önerilerin dışında tutulacak.

11 Ağustos itibariyle sanatçılar, Spotify for Artists aracılığıyla profillerinin bir yapay zeka kişiliğini temsil ettiğini beyan edebilecek.

Spotify, etiketin uygulanmasında yalnızca sanatçıların kendi beyanını esas almayacak; insan değerlendirmesini yapay zeka destekli inceleme araçlarıyla birlikte kullanacak.

Spotify tarafından profilleri etiketlenen sanatçılar bilgilendirilecek ve kendilerine beyanda bulunma ya da itiraz etme imkanı sunulacak.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Main alba channel
title: Le cinéma libertaire, quand les films font l'Histoire
content:
Le cinéma libertaire


Quand les films font l’Histoire


de


Verónica Vigil y José María Almela


Titre original :


“El cine libertario : Cuando las películas hacen historia”


Espagne – 2010 – 60’


Version originale espagnole sous-titrée en français


Lorsque la guerre civile espagnole éclate en juillet 1936, le syndicat anarchiste CNT socialise l'industrie cinématographique en Espagne. À Madrid et à Barcelone, les travailleurs du cinéma prennent en charge, par l'intermédiaire du syndicat, les moyens de production et de nombreux films sont réalisés. Cela donne lieu à une période unique qui ne s'est jamais reproduite dans aucune autre cinématographie mondiale. Bien que le pays soit plongé dans une guerre sanglante, entre 1936 et 1938, des films aux thématiques très variées sont tournés et sortis en salle : drames sociaux, comédies musicales, films engagés, documentaires de guerre. Ils composent une mosaïque hétéroclite qui donne lieu à l’un des moments les plus insolites et originaux de l’histoire du cinéma espagnol. À travers les témoignages de différents experts, ainsi que le récit à la première personne du directeur de la photographie et restaurateur espagnol Juan Mariné, qui a débuté sa carrière cinématographique en travaillant sur ces films, le documentaire passe en revue chacune des productions qui constituent un héritage exceptionnel du cinéma espagnol.


Documentaire dont il existe une version courte, nominée aux Goya 2011 dans la catégorie « Meilleur court-métrage documentaire »,

author: Unknown
title: EMEP calls on the government to abandon the 'Terror-Free Turkey’ narrative and take concrete steps
content:
During a press conference at the Southeastern Journalists Association in Amed (Tr: Diyarbakır), EMEP (Labour Party) Chair Seyit Aslan evaluated the draft “Law on Strengthening National Solidarity and Social Cohesion,” which was prepared as part of the Peace and Democratic Society Process and passed by the Parliament yesterday.


After nearly two years of discussions, Aslan said, an opportunity has emerged to bring an end to four decades of armed conflict. However, he criticized the way the draft law had been prepared.


Denouncing the government’s approach of denying the Kurdish question, he said the issue should be resolved through democratic and people-oriented methods, with the rights of the Kurdish people guaranteed under the Constitution.


‘We voted ‘Yes’ for the sake of peace’


Aslan explained that his party supported the draft law in order to strengthen the prospects for peace.


He stressed that voting “Yes” did not mean supporting the government’s policies, but was intended to strengthen the Kurdish people’s hope for peace, secure the release of political prisoners, and pave the way for those who lay down their arms to return safely to civilian life.


‘A general political amnesty for political prisoners should be declared’


Aslan stated that rulings of the European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) should be implemented independently of the framework law and called for the release of Selahattin Demirtaş and all those imprisoned in connection with the Kobanê trial.


He also said that people who will disarm should have their right to engage in politics guaranteed after returning to civilian life, and called for a general political amnesty for political prisoners. He added that those imprisoned in connection with the Gezi trial should also be included.


‘The ball is in the government’s court’


Aslan said the “Terror-Free Turkey” narrative should be abandoned, arguing that laying down arms alone would not be enough to achieve a lasting solution.


“The ball is in the government’s court. It is the government that must take the next step. The realization of the Kurdish people’s struggle for equality, freedom, democracy, and peace depends on the steps it takes. At the same time, we are not leaving this solely to the government’s initiative. Our responsibility is also to ensure that the Turkish and Kurdish peoples together push the government to take these steps. We must continue the joint struggle to guarantee that the Kurdish people can live together with others on the basis of equality,” Aslan said.

title: Eski ANAP milletvekili Halil Cin hayatını kaybetti
content:
Dicle ve Selçuk üniversitelerinin eski rektörü Halil Cin 84 yaşında hayatını kaybetti.

Prof. Dr. Halil Cin, akademik görevlerinin yanı sıra siyasette de yer almış, 20'nci dönem ANAP İçel milletvekili olarak Türkiye Büyük Millet Meclisinde görev yapmıştı. Cin, Milli Eğitim, Kültür, Gençlik ve Spor Komisyonu Başkanlığı görevini de üstlenmişti.

1942 yılında Mersin’in Gülnar ilçesinde dünyaya gelen Halil Cin, Ankara Üniversitesi Hukuk Fakültesinden mezun oldu. Dicle Üniversitesi rektörlüğü görevinin ardından 1984-1995 yılları arasında Selçuk Üniversitesinde rektörlük görevinde bulundu.

Halil Cin'in cenazesi memleketi Mersin'de defnedilecek.

author: anred
title: Tangos desviados: cuatro días para disputar los modos de bailar, pensar y habitar el tango
content:
Del 14 al 17 de agosto se realizará en la Ciudad de Buenos Aires la primera edición del Encuentro de Tangos Desviados – Prácticas tangueras, utopías y tensiones. Clases, talleres, conversatorios, música en vivo, performances, proyecciones, ferias y milongas reunirán a artistas, bailarines, músicxs, docentes, investigadorxs, activistas y trabajadorxs de la cultura para explorar otras formas posibles de hacer tango, desde perspectivas cuir, transfeministas, antirracistas e interseccionales.

Por ANRed 


Durante cuatro jornadas, distintas propuestas vinculadas al tango ocuparán espacios culturales de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires para poner en discusión sus formas tradicionales y abrir preguntas sobre las prácticas, los cuerpos y las comunidades que pueden construirse alrededor de esta expresión cultural.


El Encuentro de Tangos Desviados nace como una iniciativa autogestiva impulsada por un colectivo de artistas y gestorxs culturales que busca generar un espacio de intercambio entre quienes desde hace años vienen ampliando los límites del tango y desarrollando nuevas prácticas artísticas, pedagógicas y comunitarias. La convocatoria abierta recibió más de 60 propuestas provenientes de distintos puntos de Argentina y del exterior.


La propuesta parte de entender al tango como una práctica cultural viva, en permanente transformación. Desde allí, el encuentro propone poner en diálogo la danza con la investigación, la música, la performance, las pedagogías críticas y la reflexión política. La pregunta que atraviesa las actividades es también una disputa: qué tango se quiere construir hoy y qué comunidades es posible imaginar a través de él.


En un contexto marcado por el crecimiento de los discursos de odio y distintas formas de violencia contra las diversidades, lxs organizadorxs plantean el encuentro como un acto de reunión y una práctica política y afectiva. El objetivo es que esta primera edición pueda convertirse en un espacio de referencia para el intercambio, la investigación y la construcción colectiva en torno a los llamados tangos disidentes.


Cuatro jornadas para desviarse del tango conocido


La apertura será el viernes 14 de agosto en Casa Brandon, donde desde las 19.30 se realizará una milonguita de bienvenida. La jornada incluirá la mesa “Genealogías del Tango Queer”, lectura del manifiesto, una práctica milonguera y presentaciones de Sofía de Ciervo, Tita de San Telmo y la agrupación de mujeres TAURA, con host de Fifi Tango y DJ Brenda Salinas.


El sábado 15, en Sexto Cultural, tendrá lugar la Milonga de Mostras, precedida por clases y talleres que proponen revisar los roles y las formas de vincularse en la danza. Entre las actividades se encuentran “Locas ellas, locx yo”, de Tango Crítico; “Rolar el Rol”, coordinada por Xowi / X. S. Denis; “Movimiento y Conciencia”, con Nastya Rubert; y “Del Contact(o) al Tango”, con La Descalza, de La Plata.


La jornada también contará con el conversatorio “Pedagogías Utópicas”, acompañado por val flores, Cissa de Pedagogías Mostras y Lucía Rinaldi, además de la clase “Tango Exploración”, coordinada por Ale Moreira. Por la noche, la Milonga de Mostras reunirá distintas propuestas artísticas y musicales. También habrá feria, pintura en vivo y la proyección de Disitango, de Valérie Loewensberg.


El domingo 16, en Club Social 911, se realizará la Gran Milonga de Cierre, que incluirá talleres y una mesa dedicada a las memorias y perspectivas decoloniales del tango. La programación nocturna contará con Vito Gauna Trío, Trieja Andina, La Empoderada Orquesta junto a Ana Sofía Stamponi y Brisa Videla, Enroscadas y DJs, para finalizar con una milonga abierta.


El encuentro culminará el lunes 17 de agosto con “Resaca cuir”, una actividad gratuita en Nos en Vera. Será un espacio de devolución y construcción colectiva destinado a compartir lo vivido durante el festival, intercambiar reflexiones, activar el cuerpo a través del movimiento, escuchar poesía y pensar colectivamente los deseos para una segunda edición en 2027.


Un tango que se mueve


Para sus organizadorxs, la apuesta no es solamente incorporar nuevas identidades o estéticas al circuito tanguero, sino recuperar la potencia emancipatoria, orillera y colectiva del tango para imaginar otros futuros posibles.


Así, Tangos Desviados propone correrse de las fronteras que históricamente delimitaron quiénes pueden bailar, cómo deben hacerlo, qué cuerpos pueden ocupar la pista y qué vínculos son considerados legítimos. La …

author: Unknown
title: "Geri dönüşleri toplumsal gösteriye dönüştürmeden, zafer havası oluşturmadan ilerlemek gerekir"
content:
Meclis Genel Kurulu’nda yapılan görüşmeler sonucunda çerçeve yasa olarak adlandırılan “Milli Dayanışma ve Toplumsal Bütünleşmenin Güçlendirilmesi” kanun teklifi 467 kabul, 87 ret, 7 çekimser oy ile kabul edildi. Görüşmelerin bitmesinin ardından Meclis 1 Ekim tarihine kadar tatile girdi.


“Bir zafer havası oluşturmadan ilerletmek gerekir”


Yeni Yol Partisi Grup Başkanı Mehmet Emin Ekmen, Meclis’te kabul edilen çerçeve yasayı bianet’e değerlendirdi. Hazırlık aşamasındayken yasayı “bıçak sırtı bir denge” olarak nitelendiren Ekmen, sözlerine de açıklık getirdi.


Ekmen, şunları söyledi:


“Bıçak sırtı bir denge’ diye ifade ettiğim sözden muradım şuydu: Bir yanda devletin ve toplum geniş kesiminin hassasiyetleri, diğer yanda ise örgütün kendini sonlandırma ve silahsızlandırma arzusuna cevap verecek bir yasal düzenlemeye ihtiyacı vardı. Toplum geniş kesimlerinin irite olacağı bir düzenleme bu yasada yok. Örgütün de yasayı bir başlangıç kabul ederek, eksiği gediği ile sürece katılacağı yönünde kuvvetli bir kanaat var. Yasayı işletmek, mekanizmaları kurmak devletin ödevi; diğer tarafta ise, olası geri dönüşleri toplumsal bir gösteriye dönüştürmemek, bir zafer havası oluşturmadan ilerlemek gerekir.”


“Her iki taraf için büyük bir sorumluluk”


Kimsenin yanlış yapma lüksü kalmadığını belirten Ekmen, sözlerine şöyle devam etti:


“Ülke yönetimindeki otoriteleşme, süreç yönetimindeki hatalar, kanun hazırlama sürecindeki eksikliklere rağmen verilen bu büyük destek; taraflara değil, çatışmadan yorulmuş toplumun, geleceği barış ve huzur içerisinde birlikte kurma isteğine verilmiş büyük bir destektir. Bu tablo her iki taraf için de büyük bir sorumluluktur. Kimsenin yanlış yapma, süreci sürüncemede bırakma lüksü kalamamıştır.”


Yasa neden toplumsallaşamadı?


Sürecin toplumsallaşmadığı yönündeki eleştirilere değinen Ekmen, şu ifadeleri kullandı:


“Toplumsallaşamama yönü şu sebeptendi: Bu süreç doğru bir şekilde topluma aktarılmadı. Cumhurbaşkanı Sayın Erdoğan, kendi penceresinden süreci başından itibaren halka anlatamadı. Var olan güvensizliğe ilaveten yasa gecikti, hukuki belirsizlikler yaşadık; bunlar da güvensizliği besledi. Şu an Cumhurbaşkanlığına kurulacak Kurul ve Meclis’te kurulacak İzleme Heyeti bir model üretecek. Yasa, örgütün stratejik dönüşümüne katılmak isteyen üyeler, yöneticiler ve hatta kurucular için bir hukuki teminat sunuyor. Bu Kurul’un teyit ve ilanı beklemeden kurulup komisyonlar, alt kurullar, ilgili görevlendirmeler gibi mekanizmalarını oturtması ve devlet içinde bir mimari oluşturması gerekiyor. Devlet açısından Milli Güvenlik Kurulu'nun teyit ve ilan mekanizması çalıştırılmalı. Örgüt gereken adımları atmalı ve MGK ekim ayında bunu ilan etmeli.


“Bütün kesimler sürece katılmalı”


Sivil toplum kuruluşlarının sürece katılması gerektiğini ifade eden Ekmen, şöyle dedi:


“Henüz sivil toplum kuruluşları ve baroların gözlemci olarak katılımına dair somutlaşmış bir şey yok. Ancak hem Cumhurbaşkanlığındaki Kurul’un dizaynındaki geniş hareket alanı hem de Türkiye Büyük Millet Meclisi’ndeki Komisyon’un çerçevesine dair yapıcı muğlaklık istenirse geniş bir hareket alanı oluşturuyor. Başta barolar, meslek örgütleri ve barış için çaba gösteren bütün kesimler olmak üzere, süreç karşıtları dahil, sivil toplumu kuvvetli bir şekilde çalışmalara katmak gerekir.”


“Kayyım düzeni bir an önce sona ermeli”


Yerel yönetimlerin özerkliği, kayyum uygulamaları ve idari reformlara değinen Ekmen, "Biz DEVA Partisi olarak bunu özellikle hep ifade ettik. Ben gerek Adalet Komisyonu konuşmamda gerek Genel Kurul’daki konuşmamda gerekse katıldığım birçok yayında ve yazılarımda bu uygulamalara son verilmesini defaatle dile getirdim. Anayasa Mahkemesi, AİHM kararları, kayyım düzeni gibi uygulamalara bir an önce son vermeli. Bunlara yönelik çalışmalar yapılmalı, kararlara uyulmalı. Çok uzun uzadıya yol haritalarına ihtiyaç yok. Anayasa Mahkemesi, Avrupa insan hakları Mahkemesi kararları uygulanmalı, kayyım siyasetine son verilmeli. Bu toplumda bir ferahlama yaratır sürece güveni arttırır" dedi.


(FY)

author: Mag
title: Unterdrückung von Lehrkräften und ihren Gewerkschaften im Iran geht weiter – ihr Kampf auch
content:
Dossier


„

Der Kampf der Lehrer im Iran für eine gerechte Entlohnung, eine bessere Altersversorgung, eine kostenlose öffentliche Bildung, ein Ende der Privatisierung des Bildungswesens, die Verfolgung von Lehrergewerkschaftern und die Freilassung inhaftierter Lehrer ist in den letzten Monaten unaufhörlich weitergegangen. (…) Gegenwärtig befinden sich die folgenden Lehreraktivisten wegen verschiedener erfundener Anschuldigungen des Geheimdienstministeriums und der Justiz der Islamischen Republik Iran im Gefängnis. (…)  Wir verurteilen die anhaltende repressive Behandlung von aktiven Lehrkräften und Gewerkschaftern im Iran und fordern die sofortige und bedingungslose Freilassung aller inhaftierten aktiven Lehrkräfte sowie die Aufhebung des neuen Ausweisungsurteils gegen den Sprecher der Teheraner Lehrergewerkschaft, Mohammad Habibi

.“ Aus der umfangreichen englisch/französischen

Solidaritätserklärung vom 20.10.21


 des alternativen gewerkschaftlichen Netzwerk für Solidarität und Kampf mit Informationen über alle Inhaftierten und Fotos – siehe die weitere Entwicklung:


Iran verschärft landesweite Verfolgung von Lehrkräften und Gewerkschaftsaktivisten: Seit Januar 2026 mindestens 60 festgenommen, strafrechtlich verfolgt oder inhaftiert


„

Mindestens 60 Lehrer wurden festgenommen, strafrechtlich verfolgt oder inhaftiert, während die Behörden versuchen, eine der einflussreichsten zivilgesellschaftlichen Gruppen des Iran zu zerschlagen


Seitdem die iranischen Behörden die landesweiten Proteste vom Januar 2026 durch Massenmorde und weitreichende Repressionen niedergeschlagen haben, führen sie eine systematische Kampagne gegen eine der einflussreichsten zivilgesellschaftlichen Gruppen des Landes: die Lehrkräfte. Im gesamten Iran wurden im Rahmen der umfassenden Bemühungen des Staates, jegliche interne Opposition im Land zu unterdrücken, Lehrer und Aktivisten von Lehrergewerkschaften verhaftet, sind gewaltsam verschwunden, wurden unter dem Vorwurf der Gefährdung der nationalen Sicherheit strafrechtlich verfolgt, inhaftiert sowie in Einzelhaft gesteckt und ihnen wurde die medizinische Versorgung verweigert, um unabhängige Organisationsbemühungen zum Schweigen zu bringen.


Das Center for Human Rights in Iran (CHRI) hat mindestens 60 Lehrer und Gewerkschaftsaktivisten dokumentiert, die festgenommen, strafrechtlich verfolgt oder inhaftiert wurden. Die tatsächliche Zahl liegt mit ziemlicher Sicherheit weit höher, insbesondere bei Lehrern, die während der Proteste im Januar festgenommen wurden und über deren Fälle nie öffentlich berichtet wurde, sowie in kleineren Städten, wo Festnahmen oft nicht gemeldet wurden. Die beispiellose 88-tägige landesweite Internetsperre durch die Behörden hat zudem die Dokumentation des gewaltsamen Vorgehens der Regierung erheblich behindert.


„Die Islamische Republik ist entschlossen, ihre Bevölkerung zum Schweigen zu bringen, um ihre Macht zu sichern, und ihre gewaltsame Kampagne gegen Lehrer – eine der wichtigsten landesweiten unabhängigen zivilgesellschaftlichen Institutionen im Iran – ist für dieses Ziel von entscheidender Bedeutung“, sagte Hadi Ghaemi, Geschäftsführer von CHRI.


Wichtigste Ergebnisse:


–    Dutzende Lehrer wurden festgenommen, oft unter Anwendung von Gewalt; es ist davon auszugehen, dass es noch viele weitere, nicht gemeldete Festnahmen gibt


–    Inhaftierte Lehrer, die ohne Kontakt zur Außenwelt und in langanhaltender Einzelhaft festgehalten werden


–    Inhaftierten Lehrern werden lebenswichtige medizinische Versorgung, Kontakt zu ihren Familien und angemessene Verpflegung verweigert


–    Lehrer, denen vage Vorwürfe im Zusammenhang mit der nationalen Sicherheit gemacht werden


–    Zu den Strafen gehören lange Haftstrafen, Auspeitschungen und interne Verbannung


 –   In den kleineren Städten des Iran sind die Verhaftungen besonders zahlreich und werden in den Medien kaum thematisiert


„Lehrer, Schüler, Aktivisten, Anwälte – eine nach der anderen versucht die Islamische Republik, unabhängige Stimmen auszuschalten, die in der Lage sind, die Gesellschaft zu mobilisieren, und die Welt muss darauf reagieren“, sagte Ghaemi. „Im Fall der Lehrer gibt es konkrete internationale Mechanismen – von der ILO über die UNESCO bis hin zu den Sonderverfahren der Vereinten Nationen –, die als Reaktion auf diese gewalttätige und kriminelle Verfolgung mobilisiert werden sollten“, fügte er hinzu.


CHRI fordert dringend:

title: [Argentina] Em defesa da terra, sua memória arde!!! Brujo presente
content:
Na última segunda-feira, 3 de agosto, às 6h40 da manhã, decidimos bloquear o trem que liga a Capital (Cidade de Buenos Aires) à cidade de La Plata, no território dominado pelo Estado sionista da Argentina.

 

Essa ação se insere no contexto da reivindicação da memória do companheiro anarquista Santiago Maldonado, o Lechu, nove anos após seu assassinato pelas mãos da Gendarmeria Nacional na comunidade mapuche de Cushamen. Sempre que o mês de agosto começa, é um chamado tanto para refletir quanto para agir, não apenas a partir da lembrança, mas desde a luta anarquista, da solidariedade e do apoio mútuo.

 

Todo mês de agosto tentamos lembrá-lo por meio da ação, não desde o martirológio, mas porque Santiago era um de nós e porque seu assassinato repercutiu no meio anarquista. Odiamos a manipulação que tanto o Estado quanto a imprensa e a esquerda já fizeram com sua identidade e porque, a cada dia que passa nesta sociedade sinistra e tecnologizada, sua prática nos lembra o que importa: a defesa da natureza e a luta pela libertação total.

 

Nesse sentido, decidimos bloquear a via na altura do riacho El Gato, onde se pretende construir a nova rampa de saída da rodovia para City Bell, devastando zonas úmidas ao longo do trajeto em nome da circulação de pessoas e mercadorias, aprofundando a destruição do pouco que resta da vida selvagem nas grandes cidades.

 

Fogo a sociedade industrial e seus defensores!

Liberdade para Milton, Eneas e todos os presos e presas!

Que viva a anarquia!
