author: A.N.A.
title: [EUA] Jornalista e idoso Mumia Abu-Jamal é mantido em detenção perpétua de forma injusta, afirmam organizações de direitos humanos em apelo às Nações Unidas
content:
28 de julho de 2026, Filadélfia. Há mais de 44 anos, o cidadão norte-americano Mumia Abu-Jamal encontra-se arbitrariamente detido na Comunidade da Pensilvânia. Hoje, o Abolitionist Law Center e uma coalizão nacional de outras organizações de direitos humanos, American Civil Liberties Union, Center for Constitutional Rights, California Coalition for Women Prisoners e Release Aging People in Prison Campaign, apresentaram uma petição a um Grupo de Trabalho das Nações Unidas sobre Detenção Arbitrária, buscando reparação. A petição apresenta evidências de que o Estado da Pensilvânia vem violando normas internacionais ao negar sistematicamente a Abu-Jamal um julgamento justo e um processo adequado de apelação, ao submetê-lo a condições de confinamento equivalentes à tortura e ao condená-lo a uma pena de morte por encarceramento, que impede que ele deixe a prisão com vida.


Abu-Jamal, de 72 anos, é um premiado jornalista de rádio e prolífico autor. Está encarcerado há mais de quatro décadas, desde dezembro de 1981. Foi preso e acusado de assassinar um policial após ser encontrado no local do crime, também baleado. Depois de ser condenado à morte, permaneceu em isolamento na ala da morte entre 1983 e 2011, durante 29 anos, uma violação flagrante das Regras de Mandela, que limitam o confinamento solitário a 15 dias. Ao longo de todo o processo, Abu-Jamal foi alvo por suas posições políticas, suas associações e sua raça, antes da prisão, durante o julgamento e ao longo do encarceramento, das apelações e dos procedimentos pós-condenação, incluindo repetidas tentativas de censurar e silenciar seus escritos e discursos políticos.


“O caso de Mumia exemplifica o racismo endêmico do sistema de punição criminal da Filadélfia nas décadas de 1970 e 1980, bem como o uso do encarceramento como ferramenta de repressão política”, afirmou Saleem Holbrook, diretor executivo do Abolitionist Law Center, escritório de advocacia de interesse público que o representa. Má conduta policial, da promotoria e do Judiciário marcou sua condenação. O julgamento de 1982, segundo a Anistia Internacional, “não atendeu aos padrões internacionais mínimos que garantem a imparcialidade dos procedimentos judiciais”.


A petição à ONU documenta claramente a discriminação racial sofrida por Abu-Jamal, assim como a privação do direito de se representar, a negação de tempo e recursos adequados para preparar sua defesa e a interferência política no processo.


“Em cada etapa, o caso contra Mumia violou princípios jurídicos fundamentais. Ele estaria livre se os tribunais aplicassem a lei ao seu caso, em vez de fazer política com a Constituição”, declarou Bret Grote, diretor jurídico do Abolitionist Law Center. “Estamos buscando uma decisão das Nações Unidas que exponha o preconceito, o racismo e a crueldade do sistema judicial no caso de Mumia.”


Abu-Jamal buscou diligentemente um novo julgamento justo por meio de recursos e procedimentos pós-condenação tanto nos tribunais estaduais quanto nos federais, mas esgotou todas as vias legais disponíveis. Embora sua pena de morte tenha sido anulada, a condenação à prisão perpétua sem possibilidade de liberdade condicional, também chamada de morte por encarceramento, constitui, segundo os peticionários, uma forma de tortura: punição cruel, desumana e degradante, em violação ao direito internacional.


“A arbitrariedade inerente a uma pena indefinida de morte por encarceramento, que não prevê revisão periódica da necessidade ou razoabilidade de sua manutenção, combinada com os muitos anos já cumpridos por Abu-Jamal, sua idade avançada, sua saúde em declínio e a ausência de risco à sociedade, viola múltiplas disposições do direito internacional”, afirmou Samah Sisay, advogada do Center for Constitutional Rights.


Agora idoso, Abu-Jamal enfrentou diversas crises médicas quase fatais, incluindo hepatite C, insuficiência cardíaca congestiva, uma emergência hiperglicêmica evitável que ameaçou sua vida e múltiplas doenças oftalmológicas que, devido ao atendimento inadequado prestado pelo Departamento de Correções da Pensilvânia, representam um risco significativo de cegueira permanente.


Como afirma a petição, Abu-Jamal é apenas um entre um número impressionante de pessoas nos Estados Unidos condenadas a morrer na prisão. Em 2020, mais de 200 mil pessoas cumpriam penas de prisão perpétua ou equivalentes à perpétua; quase 8.300 delas estavam na Pensilvânia. author: A.N.A.
title: [Espanha] Por que Ferrer Guardia não tem espaço no Museu Pedagógico de Zamora?
content:
Uma das principais críticas recebidas pelo Museu Pedagógico de Zamora (USAL) é que a Escola Moderna não aparece em sua exposição.

 

Francesc Ferrer Guardia e muitas outras experiências pedagógicas alternativas históricas são, assim, silenciadas neste museu.

 

A educação libertária não tem, portanto, espaço no museu: nem as experiências de pedagogia racionalista, nem os MRP, nem os professores de esperanto, nem as universidades populares, nem as associações profissionais revolucionárias, nem os professores e pedagogos inovadores de Zamora ou da região.

 

Também os pensadores de Zamora ligados à educação, como Agustín García Calvo, são esquecidos pelo museu; parece que nunca existiram, apesar de terem deixado uma bela marca em toda a comunidade educacional.

 

É possível criar outro museu pedagógico, muito mais agradável e com maior variedade. Vamos dar nossa contribuição para que isso aconteça. Todos nós merecemos isso.

 

Felisa de Castro

author: David Swanson
title: World BEYOND War 20th African Chapter Launched in Benin
content:
By Guy Feugap, World BEYOND War’s Africa Organizer


En français plus bas


During the 2026 World Social Forum in Cotonou, World BEYOND War officially launched its chapter in Benin, with the collaboration of

Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam – Network for Comprehensive Democracy (VK)

, bringing the movement’s total number of chapters in Africa to 20. This new chapter strengthens WBW’s ambition to build, across the continent, a movement committed to the abolition of war and the promotion of security based on justice, cooperation, and nonviolence. Since the creation of its first African chapter in Cameroon in 2020, World BEYOND War has experienced significant growth across the continent. From West Africa to East Africa, from the Great Lakes region to Southern Africa, activists, educators, researchers, and civil society actors continue to endorse our

Declaration of Peace

 and mobilize around the vision of a world beyond war.


The launch of the Benin chapter was marked by a solemn moment: the presentation of a World BEYOND War flag to Monguede Adjéhoda Tchindro, the chapter coordinator. This ceremony was particularly significant as it was the first official launch of an African chapter during a global event, in the presence of the African Organizer.


The launch of the Benin chapter, held as part of the 2026 World Social Forum in Cotonou, reflects our commitment to strengthening African peace movements, fostering exchanges among activists, and developing initiatives adapted to local realities. This took place on August 8, during the Forum’s session entitled “Building the Movement for a War-Free Benin.” During this session, we presented World BEYOND War’s mission, campaigns and approach, and opened a dialogue with Beninese actors on peace and security issues. The meeting also had a pan-African dimension. As African societies face armed conflicts, violent extremism, political tensions, population displacement, and various forms of insecurity, the launch of the Benin chapter served to invite citizens to act before crises escalate.


Indeed, the chapter coordinator describes the country’s security situation as relatively calm, and the vision of the Benin chapter as being based on the conviction that the absence of war does not mean peace. In his presentation, Monguede Adjéhoda Tchindro identified among the challenges facing Benin family and community conflicts, land and resource-related conflicts, social and political tensions, hate speech and disinformation, as well as regional security risks. The situation in Benin therefore cannot be separated from its regional environment. Borders, trade, migration, and population movements mean that crises affecting neighboring countries can quickly have repercussions in Benin. In this context, the chapter intends to adopt a preventive approach, not waiting for crises to become wars before beginning to build peace.


The Benin chapter is already considering several areas of intervention. Its priorities include peace education through conferences, training sessions, peace clubs, and activities in schools and universities; youth mobilization and training; the creation of spaces for community dialogue and mediation; as well as research and documentation on conflicts. Communication will also play an important role, particularly through the use of social media. Particular attention will be given to youth. The chapter aims to help train young people capable of becoming peace actors and ambassadors, volunteers, mediators, and creators of positive content, turning them into a force for prevention and social transformation.


World BEYOND War Lance son 20e Chapitre Africain au Bénin


Guy Feugap, Organisateur Africain de World BEYOND War


À l’occasion du Forum social mondial 2026 à Cotonou, World BEYOND War a officiellement lancé son chapitre au Bénin, grâce à la collaboration avec

Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam


– Network for Comprehensive Democracy (VK)

,  portant à 20 le nombre de chapitres du mouvement en Afrique. Cette nouvelle implantation renforce l’ambition de WBW de construire, à travers le continent, un mouvement engagé pour l’abolition de la guerre et la promotion d’une sécurité fondée sur la justice, la coopération et la non-violence. Depuis la création de son premier chapitre africain au Cameroun en 2020, World BEYOND War a connu une croissance importante sur le continent. author: Soraya Kishtwari
title: Stop Helping US Bomb Iran, UK Union Bosses Tell Andy Burnham
content:
Prime minister Andy Burnham must revoke permission for the US to use British bases for airstrikes against Iran, union chiefs have said.


In an open letter

 sent last week

, ten trade union leaders representing more than 2.3 million workers said that the war is making life harder for Britons and undermining Burnham’s cost of living pledges.


The illegal US-Israel war on Iran has disrupted the global food chain and energy supplies, sending household bills soaring. 


The union bosses noted that British households have seen their annual energy bills rise by £221 since the war began on 28 February, while monthly food bills are forecast to increase by £32.80. “Opposing this war is a necessity if the cost of living agenda is to succeed,” they wrote.


The letter was signed by the general secretaries of Unison, the National Education Union, the Communication Workers Union, the RMT, the PCS, the University and College Union, Equity, the Transport Salaried Staffs’ Association, the Bakers, Food and Allied Workers’ Union and the Fire Brigades Union.


Burnham has allowed US air strikes to be conducted from RAF Fairford in Gloucestershire and Diego Garcia, a British territory in the Indian Ocean.


“Revoking permission for the US to use these bases would have a significant impact on the US’ ability to further escalate a war that has been a catastrophe for people in the Middle East and an economic disaster for the world,” the letter said.


“We urge the prime minister to vocally and actively oppose the war and to revoke the UK’s approval of US air strikes from British territories. Most of the British public oppose these air strikes. Opposing this war is a necessity if the cost of living agenda is to succeed.”


During a trip to the US last week, UK foreign secretary Ed Miliband repeated the government’s claim that UK bases are only being used for “defensive” strikes, despite the fact the US-led war was unprovoked and has no basis in international law.  


“We did not join offensive action in this war. We’ve allowed our bases to be used for defence by our allies, our Gulf allies, and that’s absolutely the right thing to do,” he said during a meeting with his US counterpart Marco Rubio.

title: „Zeitenwende“ als Geldsegen für die Rüstungsindustrie – diese Firmen profitieren (auch auf dem Arbeitsmarkt) – andere „konvertieren“ rückwärts
content:
Dossier


„

… Von einem

neuen Super-Verteidigungsetat

 profitieren nicht nur größere deutsche Rüstungskonzerne wie Rheinmetall, Krauss-Maffei Wegmann, Hensoldt, Diehl und Heckler & Koch oder europäische Hersteller wie Airbus und der Lenkwaffenkonzern MBDA. Milliardenbeträge werden auch an US-Rüstungskonzerne wie Lockheed Martin und Boeing fließen. Branchenexperten verweisen darauf, dass der Geldsegen keine schlagartige Besserung beim Ausrüstungsstand der Bundeswehr bringen wird. Der Bau eines neuen Kampfpanzers durch Krauss-Maffei Wegmann (KMW) dauert beispielsweise zwei, drei Jahre. Hoffnung können sich KMW und Rheinmetall aber jetzt machen, dass weitere rund 230 Schützenpanzer Puma bestellt werden

…“

Artikel von Gerhard Hegmann am 27.02.2022 in der Welt online


 – siehe dazu viel zu viele Meldungen aus zu vielen Betrieben (und ein

extra-Dossier zu VW Osnabrück

 sowie ein

Dossier zu Rheinmetall in Berlin

):


Das Auto der Zukunft ist kein Panzer


„Umstrukturierungen, Entlassungen, Werksschließungen: Die europäische Automobilindustrie gerät ins Wanken und stellt ihre Produktion auf Rüstungsgüter um. (…) Die europäische Automobilindustrie befindet sich in einer tiefen Krise. Zunächst muss man jedoch klären, um welche Krise es sich handelt. Es handelt sich nicht in erster Linie um eine Ressourcenkrise. Die Aktionäre all dieser Konzerne schwimmen geradezu im Geld. Sie wurden in den letzten Jahren großzügig vergütet. In der Zeit nach der Corona-Pandemie verzeichnete die Mehrheit der europäischen Automobilhersteller einen erheblichen Anstieg ihrer Gewinne. (…) Die europäische Automobilindustrie – und insbesondere die deutsche Automobilindustrie – stützt sich seit Jahrzehnten auf drei Säulen: die langjährige Erfahrung mit Verbrennungsmotoren, die Ausrichtung auf das Premiumsegment mit großen SUVs und Modellen mit hohen Gewinnspannen sowie die außergewöhnliche Rentabilität des chinesischen Marktes. (…)


Doch heute kehrt sich dieses Muster (…) um. Während deutsche Autos früher ein Synonym für Technologie und Qualität waren, werden sie heute – in Testberichten und in der Fachpresse – wegen ihres technologischen Rückstands kritisiert und manchmal sogar verspottet, insbesondere in den Bereichen Elektromobilität, Batterietechnik, Bordsoftware und autonomes Fahren. (…) Der chinesische Markt, der es der deutschen Automobilindustrie lange Zeit ermöglicht hatte, eine Produktion abzusetzen, die weit über den Bedarf ihres heimischen Marktes hinausging und dabei beträchtliche Gewinne zu erzielen, ist entwickelt sich nun in sein Gegenteil: nicht mehr Motor der Rentabilität, sondern der Ort, an dem sich sein technologischer Rückstand offenbart. (…)


Angesichts dieser Krise gerät ein immer größerer Teil der europäischen Automobilindustrie in zwei neue Sackgassen. Die erste besteht darin, den Umstieg auf Elektrofahrzeuge weiter zu bremsen, um die Lebensdauer des Verbrennungsmotors so lange wie möglich zu verlängern. (…) Die zweite Sackgasse ist die Militarisierung des Produktionsapparats: Mehrere Hersteller suchen nun nach neuen Wachstumsfeldern in der Militarisierung ihrer Produktion. (…) Die aktuelle Krise ist kein technologisches Schicksal. Sie ist nicht vom Himmel gefallen. Sie ist das Ergebnis einer kapitalistischen Logik im Zeitalter der Monopole: Die großen Hersteller entscheiden sich dafür, eine veraltete Technologie beizubehalten, um ihre Monopolgewinne so lange wie möglich zu sichern. Nun wollen sie die Arbeitnehmerinnen und Arbeitnehmer für die Folgen dieser Entscheidungen bezahlen lassen. (…)


Es muss eine andere Logik durchgesetzt werden. Zunächst müssen die Dividenden und Aktienrückkäufe aus den gewinnbringenden Jahren herangezogen werden. Wenn ein Konzern Milliarden an die Aktionäre ausgeschüttet hat, kann er die Rechnung danach nicht den Arbeitnehmern präsentieren. Auf die Dividenden und Aktienrückkäufe, die die großen Automobilkonzerne in den letzten Jahren getätigt haben, muss eine Sondersteuer erhoben werden. Diese Mittel müssen in die Forschung und Entwicklung, in den Übergang zu Elektro- und autonomen Fahrzeugen, in die Weiterbildung der Beschäftigten und in die Sicherung von Arbeitsplätzen fließen. Kein einziger Euro an staatlicher Hilfe darf an Konzerne fließen, die Mitarbeiter entlassen, Werke schließen oder Dividenden ausschütten. Zweitens braucht es einen echten europäischen Industrieplan für die Elektrifizierung des Verkehrs: elektrische öffentliche Verkehrsmittel (Bus, Straßenbahn, U-Bahn, Zug) …

title: KNK calls on international powers to contribute to the peace process in Turkey
content:
The Kurdistan (KNK) released a statement regarding the framework law titled “Strengthening National Solidarity and Social Cohesion,” which the Turkish Parliament passed on Monday.


The Kurdistan National Congress, which considers this step a “milestone in the century-old Kurdish-Turkish conflict,” stated the following:


“The chief negotiator for the Kurdish side, Mr. Abdullah Öcalan, has taken historic steps toward this since his call for “Peace and a Democratic Society” on February 27, 2025. To ensure that this conflict is resolved politically, he and his movement have jointly declared an end to the strategy of armed struggle. Through dialogue with his movement, Mr. Öcalan has secured the dissolution of the Kurdistan Workers’ Party (PKK), which, since its founding in 1978, has fostered Kurdish national self-awareness and enabled national, political and social organization in the face of assimilation and oppression by the Turkish state. 


It is a positive development that the Turkish government has finally taken note of steps by Mr. Öcalan and the Kurdish movement and has responded with this law, and there is now hope that this will pave the way for peace and a democratic solution to the Kurdish question.


While the Framework Law is important as a first step toward a peaceful resolution of the conflict, it is not enough, because the Kurdish question cannot be resolved solely through the dissolution of the PKK, which is the central focus of the law. The resistance of the PKK represents the 29th uprising by the Kurds since World War I, after which the Republic of Turkey was founded, and the Kurds were deprived of their basic rights by the Turkish state with active international support. The PKK was not the cause of the conflict, but rather a consequence of the denial and oppression of the Kurds by successive regimes in Turkey over the last century.


Will the EU and international powers take the same step towards peace?


Resolving the Kurdish issue is not just a matter for Turkey. The conflict has lasted a century because global powers have added fuel to the fire, partly to advance their own interests. Western countries have taken sides in this conflict and have stigmatized the Kurdish diaspora in their own countries by banning the PKK and designating it as a “terrorist organization”. Any change in Turkey regarding the resolution of the Kurdish issue also requires an international shift in attitudes toward the Kurds. 


This includes ceasing the pressure on the PKK, formally removing its designation as a terrorist organization worldwide, and ending the criminalization of pro-Kurdish activism, particularly in Europe. There are approximately 2,5 million Kurds living in the diaspora whose lives and work are affected by these policies.


To ensure the success of this process, we call on the international community and particularly the European Union and the governments of Germany, the United Kingdom, France, and the United States to contribute to peace by pursuing a change of course in their policies.


Mr. Öcalan’s freedom is essential for the success of the process


Mr. Abdullah Öcalan plays a central role in this process. If he is to have any hope of success, his contribution as a key interlocutor on the Kurdish side must be facilitated and protected by conditions that genuinely allow for communication, legal safeguards, and political effectiveness. Of particular importance in this regard is the implementation of the 2014 ruling by the European Court of Human Rights on the so-called “right to hope”, which holds that life imprisonment without the possibility of release is a violation of the prohibition of torture and ill-treatment. The member states represented on the Committee of Ministers of the Council of Europe can provide their support in this matter, as the framework law did not address either the status or the terms of Mr. Öcalan’s sentence.


As the Kurdish issue is also a problem in Syria and Iran, a solution to the conflict in Turkey could also have a positive impact on Syria and Iran, two other states in which the Kurdish people are facing challenges and an uncertain future. The process in Turkey, if successful, would represent a significant step towards de-escalation and stability throughout the broader Middle East."

author: anred
title: ¡Santa sábana, Batman!
content:
«Mirá lo que querían que se votara mientras estábamos distraídos con el mundial. Si no fuera por ese trapo, esa caligrafía artesanal que hoy pintó banderas en todo el país. Si lo tenían todo craneado, desde cómo iban a venderle sin límites las tierras a los extranjeros, hasta cómo iban a poner de patitas en la calle al inquilino que se atrase un mes. La calle como único espacio público que queda, porque las plazas están valladas, las legislaturas están valladas.

Las costas de los lagos y ríos están alambradas. Esta marcha, por primera vez en años, no es reactiva: la gente salió igual aunque bajaran el capítulo de la ley de tierras. En la Mendoza de Cornejo, a calzada completa, veinte mil personas sin exagerar. Circulan videos de los manotazos de ahogado del poder al gas pimienta y al palito de abollar ideologías. Donde no hubo represión, no hubo disturbios. Con el honor que nos recuerdan los veteranos de Malvinas, y los granaderos de San Martín

, démonos todos juntos la victoria más bella.

Ni siquiera hace falta cruzar la cordillera, o ir hasta el fin del mundo a jugarse el pellejo. A veces basta con agarrar un aerosol y una sábana, y plantarte firme nomás».

 Por

Eugenia Segura, desde Mendoza, para Huella del Sur.


I


Mirá lo que querían que se votara mientras estábamos distraídos con el mundial. Si no fuera por ese trapo, esa caligrafía artesanal que hoy pintó banderas en todo el país…


Mirá todos los rincones adonde de pronto se vino a correr el spot: justo donde la lupa cuando da sobre la letra chica.


Si lo tenían todo craneado, desde cómo iban a venderle sin límites las tierras a los extranjeros, hasta cómo iban a poner de patitas en la calle al inquilino que se atrase un mes. La calle como único espacio público que queda, porque las plazas están valladas, las legislaturas están valladas.


Las costas de los lagos y ríos están alambradas. Yo abracé a la familia de un pescador que fue asesinado de un disparo en la garganta por un seguridad privada. Por ir a pescar adonde iban sus ancestros desde hace mil años: donde se juntan el lago Lolog y el río Quilquihue.


Antes usaban testaferros, pero ahora se los quieren puentear, hasta dan ganas de decirles ¡¡¡testaferros del mundo, uníos!!!


Ahora la onda es ponerse una inmobiliaria de bosques quemados, una empresita de servicios mineros, o ser pastor de almas, algo así. Todavía que te financie un narco queda feo.


Pero es como su Inocencia Fiscal, esto de la Inviolabilidad de la Propiedad Privada, esta Casta de Doncellas del Señor Tecnofeudal.


Que se diferencia del del medieval; en que aquel pagaba el ejército que lo sostenía en el poder de su bolsillo, y éstos sólo están dispuestos a pagar al guardián de la garita, que ya está contemplado en las expensas del barrio privado. Donde habitan cual doncellas en la torre, que miran enamoradas no la realidad, sino posters de Tatcher o de Hobbes, mientras escuchan canciones de Luis Miguel o los granaderos tocando ABBA. Y después titulan las leyes así. La Hojarasca y el Ómnibus.


Otra diferencia es que en el medioevo también se curtía algo como el honor. Y se usaban caballos y armaduras, en vez de computadoras y cascadas de mal gusto.


II


Ese algo que los veteranos de Malvinas nos trajeron al recuerdo. El Honor.


Con sólo agitar un trapo, un hincha en una cancha, las vueltas que da la vida. Si hasta ayer creían que habían dado todas las batallas allá lejos y en el frío, reciban este homenaje en vida de haber salvado a la Argentina entera de una que ni se la esperaban. Porque no hay victoria más bella que la que se gana sin disparar ni una sola bala.


Yo era niña cuando fueron a dar la vida, veía las revistas, las noticias, y en la escuela pegábamos algodones y papel glasé en la silueta de las islas. Y me acuerdo también de un graffitti en una pared, un estribillo de canción de una banda punk que decía:


No quiero ir a la guerra/ no quiero que me maten/ porque soy muy joven/ para ser un cadáver.


Sintetiza muy bien la angustia de una época, que se repite siempre que están en el poder estos señores que aman las murallas, las vallas, y hasta que no hagan de la General Paz un foso con cocodrilos, no paran.


Quieren ser inmortales, aunque vivan en el miedo. Solventan su brazo armado con dineros públicos.


Te gasean en el espacio público, cuando vas a festejar un partido de fútbol como cuando vas a defender un derecho, un territorio.


Lo que sea, te gasean.


III


Mientras tanto en el recinto hay delivery …

title: Antikriegstag 2026: „Friedensfähig statt kriegstüchtig! Gemeinsam für Völkerverständigung, soziale Gerechtigkeit und eine Welt ohne Krieg“ (DGB)
content:
„

Die internationalen Entwicklungen erfüllen den DGB und seine Mitgliedsgewerkschaften mit größter Sorge. Das Weltgeschehen wird zunehmend geprägt durch die Großmachtansprüche der USA, Chinas und Russlands. Für deren Durchsetzung schrecken sie auch vor der Anwendung und Androhung militärischer Gewalt nicht zurück. Wir erheben unsere gewerkschaftliche Stimme dagegen und halten unbeirrbar an unserem Grundsatz fest: „Nie wieder Krieg!“ Die aktuelle politische Debatte verschärft mit ihrer Verengung auf militärische Aspekte von Sicherheit Verteilungskonflikte und schwächt damit den gesellschaftlichen Zusammenhalt sowie die Demokratie selbst. Sicherheit ist für uns kein rein militärisches Projekt

…“

DGB-Erklärung zum Antikriegstag am 1. September 2026 vom 28. Juli 2026

 und eine Bewertung durch „SAGT NEIN! Gewerkschafter:innen gegen Krieg, Militarismus und Burgfrieden“:


DGB-Erklärung zum Antikriegstag 2026: Antimilitaristischer Druck der Basis beginnt zu wirken – aber der Burgfrieden ist längst nicht gebrochen


„

Die DGB-Erklärung zum Antikriegstag 2026 hat sich gegenüber den beiden Vorjahren erkennbar verändert. Der wachsende Widerstand in Betrieben, Gewerkschaften und auf der Straße sowie die Auseinandersetzungen auf dem DGB-Bundeskongress im Mai zeigen Wirkung. Dass der DGB die Wiedereinführung der Wehrpflicht und anderer Pflichtdienste eindeutig ablehnt und den endgültigen Verzicht auf neue US-Mittelstreckenwaffen fordert, ist ein wichtiger Fortschritt. Er bestätigt: Druck von unten verändert Positionen auch in unseren Gewerkschaften. Doch in der entscheidenden Frage bleibt die Erklärung der sozialpartnerschaftlich burgfriedlichen Logik verhaftet: Der Hauptfeind stehe woanders. Dabei steht der Hauptfeind der Werktätigen wie eh und je im eigenen Land.


Schon der erste Satz der DGB-Erklärung beschreibt die kriegerische Welt allein als Ergebnis der Konkurrenz zwischen den USA, Russland und China. Unsicht-bar bleibt ausgerechnet die Europäische Union unter dem Führungsanspruch Deutschlands. Dabei baut sie ihre militärische Handlungsfähigkeit massiv aus und positioniert sich als eigenständige geopolitische Großmacht – einschließlich atomarer Ambitionen.


Zugleich fordert der DGB die Bundesregierung lediglich auf, ihre »Rhetorik der Kriegstüchtigkeit« aufzugeben.


Doch Kriegstüchtigkeit ist längst nicht mehr nur Rhetorik, sondern Regierungsprogramm. Umso problematischer ist die Forderung, die »Widerstandsfähigkeit unserer Gesellschaft« gegen »innere und äußere Angriffe« sowie »hybride Bedrohungen« zu stärken. (…)


Dieser Kriegskurs verlangt einen Kriegshaushalt ohne Limit – finanziert durch wachsende Schulden und bezahlt durch die arbeitenden Menschen. Die Rechnung wird im Inneren präsentiert: durch Angriffe auf Rente, Gesundheit und Pflege, durch Kürzungen bei sozialer Sicherung, Bildung und öffentlicher Daseinsvorsorge sowie durch die weitere Deregulierung der Arbeitsverhältnisse. Der Kriegskurs nach außen hat seine soziale Front im Inneren. Die Entscheidung gegen Butter und für Kanonen ist längst gefallen.


Der DGB-Vorstand hält aber weiter an der Illusion fest, Aufrüstung, Kriegsvorbereitung und ein starker Sozialstaat könnten dauerhaft nebeneinander bestehen. Zum Antikriegstag fordert er, die Aufrüstung dürfe nicht zulasten des Sozialstaats gehen. (…)


Die DGB-Erklärung zum Antikriegstag 2026 ist besser als die Erklärungen der Vorjahre. Sie enthält wichtige Forderungen von uns. Doch sie vollzieht nicht den notwendigen Bruch mit Kriegsertüchtigung, imperialistischer Anmaßung und Burgfrieden. Der antimilitaristische Druck der Basis wirkt – aber er reicht noch lange nicht aus. title: Zuckerberg’s $300m Yacht Reportedly Ignored Call for Help From Stranded Boat
content:
A superyacht owned by Mark Zuckerberg failed to come to the assistance of a small boat that called for help near Alaska last week.


The 21ft motorboat issued a general request for assistance after it ran out of fuel between Petersburg and Juneau on 3 August. 


A small cruise ship that was further away than Zuckerberg’s yacht  ended up helping the boat after picking up the call from the coastguard,


Zuckerberg was not on board at the time. His spokesperson said the superyacht didn’t hear the call for help in time because it was using a different radio channel.


A passenger travelling on the Wilderness Legacy, which rescued the boat, said there was “unanimous booing” on board when the captain announced that the billionaire’s $300m 387ft yacht had failed to answer the call for help – despite its proximity to the boat.


“Our boat rescued a stranded vessel last night and apparently we did that after the Coast Guard radioed Mark Zuckerberg’s yacht – which was closer – and they repeatedly refused to respond. (There was near unanimous booing when the captain announced this),” Michael Love wrote on

Bluesky

.


“Frankly, if I was Mark Zuckerberg I would be absolutely ecstatic at a chance to do something helpful for someone in need and maybe get some good PR out of it.” 


A spokesperson for Zuckerberg denied the accusations. In an email to the

Alaskan Beacon

, which initially reported the incident, they said: “Mark and his family were not on board at the time of the incident. 


“As the Coast Guard noted, the boat was not in distress, and by the time the crew reviewed the Coast Guard contact on a different radio channel from the one they were operating on, the assist was already underway. We’re grateful all parties are safe.” 


The incident has drawn renewed attention to criticisms of the tech billionaire’s extreme wealth. 


“I live in Juneau and I’ve been having to look at that excessive eyesore parked up in Auke Bay for too long now,” a local resident wrote on

Reddit

.

 “Fuck Zuckerberg.”

title: 100 miners taken into custody
content:
Mine workers affiliated with Elazığ Eti Gümüş and Doruk Madencilik, companies under Yıldızlar SSS Holding, and members of the Independent Miners’ Union went to Ankara on Monday seeking a meeting with the Ministry of Energy and Natural Resources to demand that their rights be upheld.


The workers traveled to Ankara from Elazığ and Eskişehir. Around 100 workers were taken into custody at the exit of the National Library metro station. Those detained include Gökay Çakır, General President of the Independent Miners’ Union. Speaking in front of the ministry, union lawyer Lütfi Sabri Batı said: “We came to the ministry that made promises to us. If the ministry is not going to resolve the issue, the state should pay the workers their dues. Our actions will continue until all the workers receive their rights.”

title: Panel on Peace and Democratic Society Process in Brescia
content:
A panel titled “The Peace Process in Turkey: Perspectives and Expectations” was held at the Festa di Radio Onda d’Urto 2026. The panel was attended by former HDP MP Idris Baluken, lawyer and human rights defender Şerife Ceren Uysal, and artist Rosida Koyuncu as speakers. 


Brescia-based independent broadcaster Radio Onda d’Urto has organised an annual festival since 1992, bringing together music, culture and political debate in support of its activities. Every year, the festival programme also includes events addressing the problems, culture and struggles of the Kurdish people. This year, the radio put the Peace and Democratic Society Process in Turkey on its agenda.


 


The panel emphasised that, alongside ending the conflicts, ensuring lasting peace requires guaranteeing democratic rights, recognising freedom of language and identity, removing obstacles to political organisation, and ensuring the democratic transformation of society.


Baluken: The Kurdish movement has sought a peaceful solution for more than 30 years.


Idris Baluken said that the Kurdish Freedom Movement and Abdullah Öcalan have been pursuing a democratic and political solution in line with a peace paradigm for more than 30 years.


Baluken said: “As a politician who, while I was an MP, travelled both to Imrali and Kandil and took part in numerous meetings with Mr Öcalan as well as with the KCK and PKK Executive Council, I can say this with complete confidence: The position they are in today is still the position they have defended for 30 years.”


Baluken said that the Kurdish movement is not concerned solely with the problems of the Kurdish people, adding that a democratic and peaceful solution could offer a new model for the peoples of Turkey and the Middle East. He continued: “They are not concerned only with the Kurdish people. They are concerned with all the peoples of Turkey, all the peoples of the Middle East and, indeed, the entire human family. By achieving this democratic and political solution, they want to provide the peoples of Turkey and the Middle East with a model that will allow them to breathe.”


Baluken said that Öcalan has assessed the Middle East as having been experiencing a Third World War for more than 30 years, and warned that unless a democratic and peaceful solution is developed, all of humanity, particularly the peoples of the Middle East, could once again face great suffering.


Baluken stated that, despite the severe conditions of isolation, Öcalan had carried the peace paradigm to the present day with great determination. He said that the Kurdish movement had created a social reality reaching millions from meetings involving just a few people under conditions of war, adding that this accumulated experience could generate important values for Turkey, the Middle East and all humanity on the basis of democratic politics.


Ceren Uysal: Peace is also a responsibility


In her speech entitled “Peace Is a Responsibility,” Şerife Ceren Uysal said that peace means not merely silencing weapons, but also ensuring democracy, equality and justice.


Stating that Öcalan’s “Call for Peace and a Democratic Society” encompasses not only the laying down of arms but also the strengthening of democratic society and politics, Ceren Uysal said that criticising the shortcomings of the process and supporting efforts for peace are not contradictory: “We can say that the current framework of the process is inadequate while at the same time recognising that the steps taken are important. While demanding more, we do not have to wish for the possibility of peace to disappear.”


Uysal pointed out that peace processes often begin under conditions in which trust, justice and legal arrangements have not yet been fully established, and said: “Peace is not a reward granted once all political problems have been resolved. Peace is the condition that makes it possible to resolve these problems. Supporting the possibility of peace is not a favour; it is a responsibility.”


Koyuncu: All sections of society need peace


Artist Rosida Koyuncu said that peace is necessary not only for the direct parties to a conflict but for all sections of society. Emphasising the importance of making the peace process a societal process, Koyuncu said that different identities and social groups should participate in the process.


Rosida Koyuncu said: “All sections of society need peace. For lasting peace to be achieved, society needs to complete its process of …

title: CDK-F: A historic first step on a road still to be built
content:
The Kurdish Democratic Council in France (CDK-F) welcomes the adoption, on 10 August 2026, by the Grand National Assembly of Turkey, of the law establishing a first legal framework for the peace and democratic society process that has been underway for nearly two years.


In a statement, the CDK-F said: "After more than four decades of conflict, generally considered to have begun on 15 August 1984 and which has cost the lives of tens of thousands of people, this decision by the Turkish Parliament constitutes a historic milestone. It must nevertheless be understood for what it is: not the culmination of a peace process, but its legal beginning.


As Kurdish leader Abdullah Öcalan stated in his message conveyed on 3 August 2026: 'A thousand-kilometre road begins with a first step.' That first step has now been taken. It is now up to all sides to continue along the road."


Historic decisions taken to give peace a chance


The statement added: "To understand the significance of the current situation, we must recall the path that has been travelled. After several decades of conflict, a new dynamic emerged in autumn 2024.


On 27 February 2025, from İmralı prison island, Kurdish leader Abdullah Öcalan issued his “Call for Peace and a Democratic Society”, calling on the PKK to convene its congress, lay down its arms and dissolve itself. This initiative marked a historic turning point. In the days that followed, the PKK declared a ceasefire.


Then, on 5, 6 and 7 May 2025, its 12th Congress convened. On 12 May, its decisions were made public: an end to the armed struggle conducted under the name of the PKK and the dissolution of its organisational structure. This decision formally brought to an end an organisation that had waged an armed struggle against the Turkish state for more than forty years. France itself publicly acknowledged this dissolution and the announced end of the armed struggle.


A further step was taken on 11 July 2025, near Sulaymaniyah, in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq: a first group of fighters publicly destroyed their weapons. French diplomacy welcomed the ceremony at the time, recalling that it followed Kurdish leader Abdullah Öcalan’s 27 February call and the announcement of the PKK’s dissolution on 12 May.


On 26 October 2025, another major decision was announced: the withdrawal of fighters still present on Turkish territory to areas of Iraqi Kurdistan, in order to eliminate the risk of new clashes and provocations that could derail the process.


These decisions must be considered as a whole. Ceasefire. End of the armed-struggle strategy. Dissolution of the PKK. Destruction of weapons. Withdrawal of combat forces from Turkish territory."


The statement added: "The Kurds and the Kurdish movement thus took decisions of historic significance in order to give a political and democratic resolution every possible chance.


Peace, however, cannot be built through the actions of only one side. 10 August 2026, politics finally begins to take over from weapons. The creation within the Grand National Assembly of Turkey of the Commission for National Solidarity, Fraternity and Democracy constituted the first parliamentary institutionalisation of the process.


On 18 February 2026, after several months of work, this commission adopted its report by 47 votes to 2, with one abstention. Its official mandate included work in the areas of freedom, democracy and the rule of law. The Parliament’s adoption, on 10 August 2026, of the first law intended to establish a legal framework for disarmament, return and reintegration therefore represents a change in the nature of the process.


For the first time since the opening of this new process, political commitments are beginning to be transformed into law. This is a major development. But no one should misunderstand its significance. The law of 10 August is not peace. It is an instrument that makes it possible to begin building peace. Its implementation is, moreover, subject to several stages and verification mechanisms. The framework includes measures relating to investigations, prosecutions and sentences for certain people concerned by the process, as well as institutional monitoring mechanisms. We must therefore guard against both premature enthusiasm and pessimism."


Now the law must produce results


The statement underlined that "a law that is not effectively implemented will not be enough to build the trust necessary for lasting peace. The next stage must …

title: ทุกคนพากันประหลาดใจที่พวกอนาธิปไตยเป็นอนาธิปไตย
content:
วิลเลียม กิลลิส. บทความต้นฉบับ

: Ev

eryone Wildly Surprised That Anarchists Are Anarchists

. 9 ธันวาคม 2016. แปลเป็นภาษาไทยโดย Kin


ตลอดความปั่นป่วนทางการเมืองในช่วงปลายเดือนที่ผ่านมา ผู้คนจากแทบทุกค่ายทางการเมือง รวมถึงคนจำนวนไม่น้อยที่ควรจะรู้เรื่องนี้ดีกว่าใคร พากันเดือดดาลที่พบว่าพวกอนาธิปไตยยังคงประณามและต่อต้านอำนาจนิยมอย่างคงเส้นคงวา ไม่ว่าจะเป็นคาสโครหรือทรัมป์ ไม่ว่าจะเป็นเหมาอิสต์หรือพวกขวาจัด พูดง่ายๆ คือดูเหมือนพวกเขาจะตกตะลึงกันเหลือกันที่พวกอนาธิปไตยเป็นอนาธิปไตย ตัวอย่างเพี้ยนๆ อย่างหนึ่งคือตัวผมเองถูกเรียกว่าเป็น “พวกยึดหลักการจนหน้ามืดตาตัว” จน “สนใจแต่เรื่องการต่อต้านอำนาจนิยมเท่านั้น” ก็ใช่น่ะสิ ไม่งั้นจะเป็นอนาธิปไตยไปทำไมกัน ความตกอกตกใจที่แสดงออกมาเหล่านี้ปรากฏอยู่ทั่วไปในโซเชียลมีเดีย ในหมู่ฝ่ายซ้าย เราเห็นคำอุทานทำนองนี้หลากไหลไม่ขาดสาย “เดี๋ยวนะ คุณต่อต้านแม้กระทั่งเผด็จการฝ่ายซ้ายด้วยน่ะเหรอ?!!” “เดี๋ยวนะ คุณต่อต้านแม้กระทั่งนักชาตินิยมชนพื้นเมืองด้วยน่ะเหรอ?!!” (ขณะที่ฝ่ายขวาเองก็แสดงอาการงุนงงไม่แพ้กันหรืออาจจะเพี้ยนกว่าเสียอีก เมื่อพบว่าการล้มเลิกรัฐย่อมหมายถึงการล้มเลิกพรมแดมด้วย หรือเมื่อพบว่าการยึดมั่นในทางจริยธรรมต่อแนวคิดเรื่องเสรีภาพย่อมหมายถึงการต่อต้านอย่างไม่ประนีประนอมต่ออุดมการณ์รวมหมู่ที่เป็นภัยและกดขี่อย่างลัทธิคนขาวเป็นใหญ่และระบอบชายเป็นใหญ่)


แน่นอนว่าในทางปฏิบัติย่อมมีข้อพิจารณาเชิงยุทธศาสตร์ที่ซับซ้อนอยู่บ้าง แต่ชาวอนาธิปไตยจะไม่หยุดยึดถือคุณค่าแบบอนาธิปไตย และจะไม่หยุดทำงานเพื่อมุ่งไปสู่เป้าหมายแบบอนาธิปไตย เรื่องนี้ไม่ควรทำให้ใครประหลาดใจเลยแม้แต่น้อย กระนั้น ปรสิตทางความคิดที่แพร่ระบาดมากับการเลือกตั้งสหรัฐฯ ได้เผยให้เห็นอีกครั้งว่า ผู้คนจำนวนมากไม่ได้มองอนาธิปไตยในฐานะปรัชญาจริยศาสตร์หรือชุดคุณค่า หากแต่มองมันเป็นเพียงวัฒนธรรมย่อยประหลาดๆ ภายในก๊กเหล่าทางการเมืองของตนเองหรือของฝ่ายศัตรู ไม่ก็มองว่าเป็นเพียงชุดเครื่องมือและยุทธวิธีบางอย่างเท่านั้น


อนาธิปไตยไม่ได้ถูกนิยามด้วยสังกัด และไม่ใช่ธงที่จะหยิบใช้ได้ตามสะดวก นิยามของมันปรากฏอยู่แล้วในชื่อ นั่นคือ an-archia ไร้เจ้าเหนือหัว พวกเขาต่อต้านการครอบงำและการบีบบังคับมนุษย์ทุกรูปแบบ พวกเขาแสวงหาโลกที่อิสรภาพและความเป็นไปได้ขยายออกไปไม่สิ้นสุด เมื่อสิ่งที่จำกัดและควบคุมพวกเราอยู่ถูกถอนรากหรือถูกทำให้หมดความหมาย พวกเราคิดว่าวิสัยทัศน์ดังกล่าวเป็นไปได้ เพราะเราไม่คิดว่าอิสรภาพของปัจเจกชนแต่ละคนเป็นสิ่งที่ขัดแย้งกันเอง เราไม่ได้ตัดแบ่งโลกออกเป็นกลุ่มก้อน ตรงกันข้าม พวกเราพยายามสร้างโลกที่เชื่อมโยงกันอย่างกว้างขวางเพราะมองอิสรภาพในฐานะสิ่งที่เป็นองค์รวม


อนาธิปไตยคือถ้อยแถลงอันเรียบง่ายที่ว่า “อิสรภาพของทุกคนเป็นสิ่งจำเป็นต่ออิสรภาพของข้าพเจ้า ข้าพเจ้าจะมีอิสรภาพอย่างแท้จริงก็เมื่อจิตใจทั้งปวงมีอิสรภาพอย่างเท่าเทียมกัน อิสรภาพของผู้อื่นไม่ได้ลบล้างหรือจำกัดอิสรภาพของข้าพเจ้า ตรงกันข้าม มันคือเงื่อนไขเบื้องต้นและเครื่องยืนยันที่จำเป็นยิ่งต่ออิสรภาพของข้าพเจ้าเอง”- บาคุนิน


เราใส่ใจทุกคนและมุ่งปลดปล่อยทุกคน ไม่ใช่แค่มิตรสหายหรือเพื่อนร่วมชาติของเรา ไม่ใช่แค่ผู้คนในเผ่าวงศ์ทางวัฒนธรรมบางกลุ่ม เราไม่ใช่ฝ่ายซ้ายที่ใส่ผ้าโพกศีรษะ ไม่ใช่ฝ่ายขวาที่ใส่โบว์หูกระต่าย เราคือชาวอนาธิปไตย เราไม่ได้ต่อสู้เพื่อกลุ่มของคุณ เราต่อสู้เพื่ออิสรภาพ


นั่นหมายถึงการต่อต้านข้อจำกัดทุกรูปแบบ ตั้งแต่เผด็จการ ตำรวจ นักการเมือง ไปจนถึงการบังคับใช้เจตจำนงของเสียงข้างมาก ตั้งแต่วิธีคิดแบบเอาง่ายเข้าว่าที่คอยกัดกินสติปัญญาเพราะหลงบูชาสิ่งสมมติอย่างองค์กรและอัตลักษณ์รวมหมู่ ไปจนถึงเทพเจ้าและผีสางนางไม้ ตั้งแต่ระบบเศรษฐกิจที่ทำให้ผู้คนนับพันล้านต้องยากจนและอดอยากภายใต้ชื่อเรียกหนึ่ง ไปจนถึงระบบเศรษฐกิจที่ทำสิ่งเดียวกันภายใต้ชื่อเรียกอีกแบบหนึ่ง และอื่นๆ อีกมาก


การต่อสู้เพื่อเสรีภาพไม่ได้สิ้นสุดลงด้วยข้อเรียกร้องผิวเผิน เช่น ระบบกรรมสิทธิ์ที่ดีกว่าเดิม หรือการยุติลัทธิคนขาวเป็นใหญ่และลัทธิล่าอาณานิคม มันแผ่ขยายออกไปอย่างไร้ขอบเขตได้เท่ากับจักรวาล และหยั่งลึกลงได้เท่ากับความสัมพันธ์ระหว่างจิตใจสองดวง ไม่มีสิ่งที่เรียกว่า “ดีพอแล้ว” เช่นเดียวกับที่ไม่มีสิ่งที่เรียกว่า “อันนี้คือข้อยกเว้น” อนาธิปไตยไม่ประนีประนอมพอๆ กับที่มันหาญกล้า


เราไม่อาจหักหลังทีมของคุณได้ เพราะเราไม่เคยอยู่ข้างใครนอกจากอิสรภาพ.

title: Verleihung der BigBrotherAwards 2026 am 25. September in Bielefeld und online
content:

BigBrotherAwards findet am 25.09.2026 (Freitag), ab 18:00 Uhr im Rahmen eines Gala-Abends in der Hechelei im Ravensberger Park in Bielefeld statt. title: Ömer Öcalan publishes family photo from İmralı visit for the first time
content:
Ömer Öcalan, the nephew of Abdullah Öcalan and an MP for the Peoples’ Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party) for Urfa province, shared for the first time on his social media account a photograph taken during the family's visit to the Kurdish leader on October 31, 2025.


Öcalan’s sister Fatma Öcalan, his nephews Ömer Öcalan and Ali Öcalan and his niece Berfin Öcalan attended the mentioned family visit last year to Imrali Island Prison, where the Kurdish leader has been incarcerated since 1999.

title: Understanding correctly what happened 42 years ago and what is happening today
content:
The bill entitled the “Law on Strengthening National Solidarity and Social Integration,” referred to as the “root law” or “framework law,” passed the Parliamentary Justice Commission following intense debate. Clearly, similar debates will continue in the General Assembly, and eventually the bill will pass and become law. Thus, the century-long Kurdish struggle for existence and freedom will have been moved from the gallows to the framework of a law.


It is very clear that this law is a law specifically concerning the PKK. Of course, the law does not in itself provide a solution; in other words, it does not bring about Turkey’s democratisation or resolve the Kurdish question. For this reason, it has been subject to extensive and intense criticism from many different perspectives. If this is its position, then what is the meaning and importance of this law? The answer is as follows: The law in question gives the parties the opportunity to engage in politics and conduct a political struggle. This means that without such a law, there would be no possibility of engaging in politics; and without the possibility of engaging in politics, war would come onto the agenda. Therefore, those who categorically reject this law are people who want war, or, more accurately, profiteers from war.


At this point, we can classify the approaches to the law into three categories:


- Those who embrace and accept the law as it stands. These are state and government circles, because they themselves drafted the law and submitted it to Parliament. At this point, it is important to correct a misconception. Because of some statements and publications, the impression has been created that the law was drafted in Imrali and that Kurdish People’s Leader Abdullah Öcalan also accepted the law as it stands. Clearly, this is not true. Leader Abdullah Öcalan considered the enactment of such a law to be of historic importance, but he did not accept the law as it stands. Many of Leader Abdullah Öcalan’s views and proposals were not included in the law. The law was drafted by the AKP-MHP alliance.


- Those who consider the approval of the law important even in this form, but also regard it as flawed and inadequate in many respects and criticise it accordingly. Many left-wing and democratic circles, including the Kurdish Freedom Movement, have criticised the law at every stage and put forward their views and proposals. First and foremost, they pointed out that the law would not even be capable of being implemented on its own and would have to be complemented by many new democratisation laws in order to be implemented. They stated that the time had come to struggle for the enactment of such laws. In other words, they viewed the law as opening the way for political and legal struggle and considered it important for that reason. They described this situation as a “new beginning” and “opening the door.”


- Those who categorically reject the law. Fascist circles such as the IYI Party and the Victory Party, as well as some social-nationalist circles, fall into this category. It appears that there are many other groups in this category that have not openly revealed themselves. The most accurate way to describe such circles is as “profiteers”: forces that profit and gain advantages from the Kurds waging war against the states of the region, particularly Turkey. There are many such forces both within Turkey and throughout the region and the world.


It is highly useful to repeat once more, because of its importance, a sentence we wrote above: Those who categorically reject the “framework law” passed by Parliament today are essentially people who want war. They are people who want the war between the Kurds and the Republic of Turkey, which has lasted for 100 years; the war between the PKK and the Republic of Turkey, which has lasted for 41 years; and the war between the Kurds and the Ottoman and Turkish states, which has lasted for 200 years, to continue. Even if the current law had no other meaning, it represents an attempt to put an end to this state of war. It is the outcome of all these processes of war and conflict. From this perspective, it is necessary at least to establish a proper connection between it and the most recent PKK war.


If we look carefully, today, in August 2026, an attempt is being made to establish an agreement aimed at ending a war and to enact a law that will make this possible. So when did this war begin? Very clearly, it began 42 years …

author: Unknown
title: Di erdheja Kolombiyayê de hejmara miriyan derket 132an
content:
Li Kolombiyaya welatê Amerîkaya Başûr, di erdheja bi pileya 7,4an ya ku duh çêbû de hejmara kesên ku canê xwe ji dest dane derket 132an.


Yekîtiya Paytextên Kolombiyayê (Asocapitales) li ser rewşa dawî ya piştî erdheja 7,4 pileyî ya ku welat hejand daxuyaniyek da. Yekitiyê da zanîn ku hejmara kesên di erdhejê de mirine bûye 132 û zêdetirî 700 kesî jî birîndar bûne.


Li gorî çapemeniya neteweyî, li Pereira, Cali, Quibdo, Manizales û Armeniayê ku herî zêde zirarên giyanî û malî lê çêbûne, rewşa awarte hat ragihandin û li van bajaran ji ber sedemên ewlehiyê qedexeya derketina derve hat sepandin.


Li Kolombiyayê bi pileya 6,6an erd hejiyaye


25 Gulan 2023


Xebatên lêgerîn û rizgarkirinê li bajaran bênavber berdewam dikin. Ji van bajaran herî zêde li Pereirayê wendahî çêbûne û 60 kesî canê xwe ji dest da.


Li gorî çapemeniyê, ji bo 188 kesan serlêdana windabûnê hatiye kirin û fikar hene ku hejmara miriyan hîn zêdetir bibe.


Hate ragihandin ku li Cali, bajarê sêyemîn ê herî mezin ê welêt e, ji ber erdhejê hin rê hilweşiyane û 10 nexweşxane nikarin xizmetê bidin; ji paytext Bogota û Medellinê tîmên lêgerîn û rizgarkirinê ji bo piştgiriyê hatin şandin bo herêmê.


Li Quibdo û Manizalesê jî erdhej bû sedem ku xizmetên av, elektrîk, telekomunîkasyonê û veguhastinê asteng bibe.


Li Caliyê qedexeya derketina derve hat ragihandin


Şaredarê Caliyê Alejandro Eder di daxuyaniya xwe ya bo çapemeniyê de diyar kir ku ji bo pêşîgirtina li bûyerên talanê û dabînkirina ewlehiyê qedexeya derketina derve hat ragihandin û destnîşan kir ku ev biryar ji bo ku tîmên rewşa lezgîn û rizgarkirinê xebatên xwe bi rengekî ewletir û leztir bimeşînin hatiye girtin.


Navenda Lêkolînên Jeolojîk ya DYAyê (USGS) ragihandibû ku erdhejek bi mezinahiya 7,4 pileyî çêbûye û navenda wê nêzî 5 kîlometre rojhilatê bajarokê San Jose del Palmarê yê li rojavayê Kolombiyayê ye.


Li Venezuela, Ekvador û Panamadayê jî hatibû hiskirin


Erdhej ji bilî Kolombiyayê, li herêmên cûda yên Venezuela, Ekvador û Panamadayê jî hatibû hiskirin.


Li gorî nûçeya malpera Telesurê ku navenda wê li Venezuelayê ye, ji ber erdheja li Kolombiyayê, li Venezuelayê rûyê derveyî yê hin avahiyan bi qismî hilweşiyane û zirar gihîşt katedralek û balafirgehekê.


(HA/AY)

author: Unknown
title: Process will move forward if doors of Imrali open
content:
The law that had been expected for months has finally been passed. It is not a law that meets expectations. In general, it has been described as a beginning. Kurdish People’s Leader Abdullah Öcalan said that a thousand steps begin with one step. Therefore, this law is neither a law that will ensure democratization nor one that will resolve the Kurdish question. It is merely the beginning of the steps that need to be taken. What is important is to make these steps continuous through this beginning and reach the destination. The Kurdish People’s Leader said that a thousand-kilometre journey begins with a single step, meaning that the goal can be achieved through the struggles and efforts that follow.


There is a form of denialism in Turkey unlike anything seen anywhere else in the world. Millions of Kurds have been subjected to attempts at Turkification through physical massacres and cultural genocide. For 100 years, policies and practices have been pursued to turn Kurdistan into an area for the expansion of Turkish nation-building. The Kurdish Freedom Movement clearly exposed this reality in its 1978 manifesto.


The Turkish state has pursued this policy in a multidimensional and comprehensive manner for a century. It was not only Turkish politics but society as a whole that was shaped in a way that denied the existence of the Kurds. So much so that saying “I am a Kurd” became considered the gravest of crimes. It reached the point where no one could even think of mentioning Kurdish existence in the political or public sphere. In Turkey, one could not say such a thing! Even bringing Kurdish identity to mind was unacceptable. When Ahmet Kaya announced that he would sing a Kurdish song on his upcoming album, the reaction and expressions on the faces of those in the hall are still before our eyes. Ahmet Kaya was attacked as though the gravest crime in the world had been committed. He was shocked because he had never expected such a reaction. This shock led Ahmet Kaya to a new level of awareness.


Until Devlet Bahçeli called on the Kurdish People’s Leader, the political, social and cultural spheres had all been shaped along these lines. Every sphere in Turkey had been shaped by such a mindset that even indirectly mentioning the Kurdish question and its resolution was not considered normal. There may be those who say that the mindset that prevailed around the time Özal was killed no longer exists. However, since 1993, the special-war policies have inflamed chauvinism and hostility toward the Kurds to such an extent that the reactionary mindset within the state and political sphere has also been injected into society. Especially after 2015, the special war waged by the Turkish state polluted not only the political sphere but also the social sphere. In trying to crush the Kurds, the Turkish state disrupted and poisoned the social fabric of Turkish society. The process that Rêber Apo sought to develop on the basis of his February 27, 2025, Call for Peace and a Democratic Society is encountering this obstacle more than anything else.


Rêber Apo’s [Abdullah Öcalan] conducting of the process with the meticulousness of a goldsmith is also connected to the political and social climate created in Turkey. With both great determination and patience, he is trying to advance this process in the direction of democratization. In this respect, he is also educating Turkish politics and society through their own reality. Because in Turkey, both intellectual and political thinking, as well as Turkish society itself, operate in a direction contrary to their historical and social reality and political dialectics. Rêber Apo is also striving to bring this mindset back toward the right path and common sense. This is why he refers to historical Turkish-Kurdish relations and grounds them in historical realities. Emphasizing Kurdish-Turkish relations does not express an understanding or approach opposed to other peoples. Indeed, such an understanding, approach or practice does not exist in the historical and social reality. Hostility and wrongdoing directed against peoples and faiths emerged as a result of the nationalist poison and nation-state conception of Western modernity.


Rêber Apo also wants to correct this mistaken philosophy and mindset. These negative aspects cannot be overcome without resolving the Kurdish question in Turkey; Turkey cannot return to its historical and social reality and its natural social and political condition …

title: Güney Kore'de 179 kişinin öldüğü uçak kazasıyla ilgili kurumlara baskın
content:
Güney Kore’de 179 kişinin yaşamını yitirdiği Jeju Air uçak kazasına ilişkin soruşturma sürüyor. Polis, soruşturma kapsamında bazı kamu kurumlarına baskın düzenleyerek arama yaptı.

Yonhap’ın haberine göre polis ekipleri, 29 Aralık 2024’te meydana gelen kazayla ilgili soruşturma kapsamında Kore Havaalanları Kurumu (KAC), Ulaştırma Bakanlığı ve Busan Havacılık Bölge Ofisi'nde arama gerçekleştirdi.

Operasyonlarda, kazaya ilişkin “mesleki ihmal” şüphesiyle soruşturulan 74 kişi hakkında ek delil toplanmasının amaçlandığı belirtildi.

Bangkok-Muan seferini yapan Jeju Air’e ait Boeing 737-800 tipi “7C2216” sefer sayılı yolcu uçağı, 29 Aralık 2024’te Güney Kore’nin Muan kentindeki havalimanına inişi sırasında kaza yapmıştı.

Uçağın iniş takımları iniş sırasında açılmamıştı. 6 mürettebat ve 175 yolcunun bulunduğu uçak, pistte ilerledikten sonra kontrolden çıkarak havalimanındaki beton duvara çarpmıştı.

Kazada 179 kişi hayatını kaybetmiş, 30’lu yaşlardaki bir kadın ile 20’li yaşlardaki bir erkek mürettebat üyesi kurtulmuştu.

Yetkililer, ilk iniş girişiminde iniş takımlarının açılmadığını ve uçağın ikinci denemede zorunlu iniş yapmaya çalışırken kaza yaptığını açıklamıştı.

Kaza, Güney Kore havacılık tarihinin en fazla can kaybının yaşandığı facia olarak kayıtlara geçmişti. Kazanın ardından ülkede 7 günlük ulusal yas ilan edilmişti.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: Trump'ın İran korkusu: Ankara'dan kamyona gizlenerek dönmüş
content:
ABD Başkanı Donald Trump’ın, NATO Zirvesi için bulunduğu Türkiye’den dönüşünde uygulanan olağanüstü güvenlik önlemlerinin ayrıntıları ortaya çıktı. ABD basınında yer alan haberlere göre Trump, İran kaynaklı “inandırıcı bir tehdit” nedeniyle havaalanında gizlice başka bir uçağa geçirildi.

Trump, Ankara’da kameraların karşısında başkanlık uçağı Air Force One’a binerken görüntülendi. Ancak Washington Post ve New York Times gazetelerinin ABD’li yetkililere dayandırdığı haberlere göre Trump, uçağa binmiş gibi yaptıktan sonra apronda bekleyen bir catering aracına geçti.

Uçaklara yiyecek ve içecek taşıyan catering kamyonu, Trump’ı havaalanının başka bir bölümüne götürdü. Trump burada kendisini bekleyen C-32A tipi askeri uçağa bindirildi. Askeri uçak, Trump’ı İngiltere’deki RAF Mildenhall üssüne götürdü.

Trump’ın gizlice başka bir uçağa geçirilmesinin ardından Air Force One, planlandığı gibi Türkiye’den havalandı. Uçakta gazeteciler ve Beyaz Saray personeli bulunuyordu. Ancak Trump’ın uçakta olmadığı yolculara bildirilmedi.

Gazetecilere uçuş sırasında kabin perdelerini kapalı tutmaları talimatı verildi. Trump’ın daha sonra bu uygulamayı uçuşun “muhtemelen tehlikeli” olmasıyla açıkladığı aktarıldı.

Trump’ı taşıyan C-32A ile Air Force One, İngiltere’ye neredeyse eş zamanlı ulaştı. Trump burada Katar tarafından hediye edilen başkanlık uçağına geçerek ABD’ye dönüşünü sürdürdü.

Böylece kamuoyunda Trump’ın Türkiye’den ABD’ye kadar yolculuğunu Air Force One ile yaptığı izlenimi oluşturuldu.

Beyaz Saray, basında yer alan haberlere doğrudan yanıt vermedi. Beyaz Saray İletişim Direktörü Steve Cheung ise Trump’ın çok sayıda düşmanı bulunduğunu belirterek, güvenlik konusunda “Elimizdeki tüm imkânları kullanıyoruz” açıklamasını yaptı.

ABD basını, benzer bir güvenlik operasyonunun 2000 yılında dönemin Başkanı Bill Clinton için de uygulandığını bildirdi.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: ABD'de Meta ve TikTok'a açılan binlerce davada şirketlerin talebi reddedildi
content:
Fotoğraf: Nokia621/Wikimedia Commons CC BY-SA 4.0

ABD’de Meta ve TikTok’un platform tasarımlarının kullanıcılara zarar verdiği iddiasıyla açılan binlerce davada, şirketlerin davaları düşürme talebi mahkeme tarafından reddedildi.

The Hill’in haberine göre temyiz mahkemesi, Meta ve TikTok’un haklarında açılan davaların düşürülmesi talebine ilişkin kararını açıkladı. Mahkeme, teknoloji şirketlerinin davaların henüz erken aşamasında temyize başvurduğunu belirtti.

Kararda, sosyal medya şirketlerini kullanıcıların oluşturduğu içeriklerden kaynaklanan hukuki sorumluluktan büyük ölçüde koruyan İletişim Ahlakı Yasası’na da değinildi. Yasanın şirketlere davaların düşürülmesini sağlamak için değil, hukuki sorumluluğa karşı savunma imkanı sunduğu belirtildi.

Mahkeme, söz konusu aşamada temyiz yetkisine sahip olmadığına hükmederek Meta ve TikTok’un başvurusunu reddetti.

ABD’de Meta’ya ait platformlar ile TikTok’un tasarımının kullanıcılar üzerinde zarara yol açtığı iddiasıyla binlerce dava açılmış durumda. Davalarda özellikle platformların kullanıcıları uzun süre uygulamada tutmaya yönelik tasarımlarının zararları üzerinde duruluyor.

Meta ve TikTok ise davaların düşürülmesi amacıyla temyiz mahkemesine başvurmuştu.

ABD’de daha önce görülen benzer bir davada jüri, Meta ve YouTube’un bazı kullanıcıların ruh sağlığı üzerindeki etkilerinden kısmen sorumlu olduğuna karar vermiş ve 6 milyon dolar tazminat ödenmesine hükmetmişti.

20 yaşındaki K.G.M. tarafından açılan ve binlerce dosyanın birleştirilmesiyle görülen davada, sosyal medya platformlarının kullanımına bağımlı hale gelmenin ruh sağlığı sorunlarına yol açtığı veya mevcut sorunları ağırlaştırdığı savunulmuştu.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: DEM Party: An important threshold has been crossed; we will make peace permanent
content:
Following the adoption of the “framework law” bill by the Turkish parliament’s General Assembly with 468 votes, the Peoples’ Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party) said in a statement that “an important threshold has been crossed in the Peace and Democratic Society Process” and stressed that it would continue its struggle to make peace, democracy and equality permanent.


The statement posted by the DEM Party on its social media account reads: “An important threshold has been crossed in the Peace and Democratic Society Process, a historic process. The ‘Law on Strengthening National Solidarity and Social Integration’ was adopted by the General Assembly of the Turkish parliament with 468 votes. We hope that the law will contribute to the Peace and Democratic Society Process. We extend our thanks to all MPs and political actors who contributed through their criticisms and suggestions. From this point onward, our responsibility in the Peace and Democratic Society Process has become even greater for the peoples of Turkey and the region. Aware of this, we will continue our struggle and make peace, democracy and equality permanent in these lands.”

author: Unknown
title: Xelîl: Serêkaniyê attackers arrested
content:
Hesekê Province Internal Security Forces Deputy Commander Mehmûd Xelîl issued a statement regarding the attack on Serêkaniyê residents who returned to their homes after years of displacement.


Condemning the attacks, Xelîl said the purpose of these individual acts was to undermine security, prevent the return of forcibly displaced people and weaken efforts toward integration.


Mehmûd Xelîl continued: “As part of the rapid response to these incidents, the Internal Security Forces have begun taking the necessary security and legal measures. In this context, a number of people involved in these incidents have been arrested. Search and investigation operations targeting other individuals involved are continuing so that they can be held accountable under the relevant laws.”


Mehmûd Xelîl said their priority was to prevent all parties seeking to exploit the current situation and create chaos.


Stating that return convoys to the city of Serêkaniyê had been temporarily suspended in order to protect the safety of residents, Mehmûd Xelîl said, “The convoys will resume once the situation has stabilised and the full protection of those returning has been ensured.”

author: Unknown
title: DEM Parti’den ilk değerlendirme: MGK bir an önce raporunu hazırlamalı
content:
DEM Parti İmralı Heyeti üyesi Pervin Buldan, DEM Parti Eş Genel Başkanı Tülay Hatimoğulları, DEM Parti Antalya Milletvekili Hakkı Saruhan Oluç, TBMM Genel Kurulu'nda kabul edilen "Çerçeve Yasa" olarak bilinen Milli Dayanışma ve Toplumsal Bütünleşmenin Güçlendirilmesine Dair Kanun Teklifi'ne ilişkin ilk değerlendirmesini yaptı.


TBMM’de Çerçeve Yasa oylaması: Kim “evet”, kim “hayır” dedi?


Bugün  08:04


DEM Parti Eş Genel Başkanı Tülay Hatimoğulları, şunları söyledi:


"Çerçeve yasanın bütün Türkiye'ye ve Türkiye barışına hayırlı olmasını diliyorum. Tabii çok önemli tartışmalar yaşandı bugün Genel Kurulda. Birçok kesim kaygısını da dile getirdi elbette. Bizler de bu yasanın bir çerçeve oluşturmasını ve önümüzdeki dönemde barışın bu topraklarda tesis edilmesi için bir ilk adım olarak değerlendiriyoruz. Bu sebeple de bu yasayı önemli bir biçimde destekledik."


“MGK bir an önce raporunu hazırlasın”


Yasanın ardından atılacak somut adımların önemine dikkat çeken Hatimoğulları, sözlerine şöyle devam etti:


"Bu yasadan sonra esas atılacak somut adımlar çok önemli. Yasanın hayata geçmesi için bir an önce kurulun oluşması, MGK'nın raporunu hazırlayıp Resmi Gazete'de yayınlaması ve böylece yürürlüğe girmesi yasanın çıkması kadar önemli ve hayatidir. Bundan sonra Türkiye'nin demokratikleşmesi için atılacak somut adım ve yapılacak yeni yasalar konusunda daha güçlü adımları parlamentonun açıldığı ilk günlerde bekliyoruz."


“Bu yasanın çıkması bir başlangıç”


Hatimoğulları, "MGK kararının aylar sonrasına, hatta yeni yıla bırakılması ihtimaline" ilişkin ise "Çıkmamasını ümit ediyoruz. Çünkü biz bu çerçeve yasanın, yani bu yasanın çıkmasının bir başlangıç olduğunu her fırsatta ifade ettik" dedi.


AKP'li Gül'den çerçeve yasa açıklaması: Bu model bir Ankara mutabakatıdır


10 Ağustos 2026


Hatimoğulları, şöyle konuştu:


"Bir an önce MGK'nın raporunu hazırlayarak bir an önce bunu Resmi Gazete'de yayınlaması cezaevleri, sürgündekiler, silah bırakıp geleceklerin demokratik siyasete katılımının önünün hızla açılması çok önemli. Süreç ne kadar uzarsa, hep ifade etmiştik ya enfekte olur, enfekte olur... Yani bu yasanın çıkması süreci enfekte olmaktan kurtarmaz. Dolayısıyla bu yasanın çıkması son derece hayati ve önemlidir ama uygulanması bir o kadar da hayati ve önemlidir. O yüzden gecikmemeli."


“Çok önemli bir sonuç alındı”


DEM Parti İmralı Heyeti üyesi ve TBMM Başkanvekili Pervin Buldan, "Çerçeve Yasa"nın kabul edilmesinin ardından yaptığı kısa değerlendirmede, "Hayırlısı olsun, öyle diyelim. İşimiz uzun, yolumuz uzun" dedi.


Demirtaş ve Mızraklı'dan 'çerçeve yasa' açıklaması: 'El ele geleceğe yürümek zorundayız'


10 Ağustos 2026


DEM Parti Antalya Milletvekili Hakkı Saruhan Oluç ise oylamaya ilişkin, "Çok önemli bir sonuç alındı. 468 evet büyük bir mutabakatı gösteriyor. Parlamento açısından da inşallah bunun toplumdaki yansıması da böyle olur. Çok sevinçliyiz" diye konuştu.


“Önemli bir eşik aşıldı”


Öte yandan DEM Parti'nin sosyal medya hesabında şu paylaşım yapıldı:


“Tarihi bir süreç olan Barış ve Demokratik Toplum Sürecinde önemli bir eşik aşıldı. “Milli Dayanışma ve Toplumsal Bütünleşmenin Güçlendirilmesi" kanun teklifi, Meclis Genel Kurulu'nda 468 oyla kabul edildi. Yasanın Barış ve Demokratik Toplum Sürecine hayırlı olmasını temenni ediyoruz. Eleştirileri ve önerileriyle katkı sunan tüm vekillere ve siyasi aktörlere teşekkürlerimizi sunuyoruz Türkiye ve bölge halkları için Barış ve Demokratik Toplum Sürecinde yükümüz bu saatten sonra daha da ağırlaşmıştır. Bunun farkında olarak mücadelemizi sürdürecek, barışı, demokrasiyi ve eşitliği bu topraklarda kalıcı hale getireceğiz.”


(FY)

author: Sofia Costa
title: Candidato à Presidência, Caiado transformou Goiás em laboratório de leis para Big Techs
content:
Em duas leis aprovadas de modo relâmpago, em apenas 48 horas cada, Goiás regulamentou temas que o Congresso Nacional ainda discute: inteligência artificial (IA), data centers e minerais críticos. A intenção, segundo especialistas ouvidos pela

Agência Pública

, é se adiantar ao debate nacional e atrair o interesse de Big Techs. Em comum aos processos, há elementos que favorecem os interesses de grandes companhias estrangeiras, falhas nas garantias para a soberania nacional e o meio ambiente, além de pouca transparência.


Antes da aprovação das leis, o ex-governador Ronaldo Caiado, que é candidato à Presidência da República pelo PSD, acumulou viagens e encontros com representantes de Big Techs, como Google e Amazon, do governo norte-americano e do setor de mineração. A viagem para uma reunião no Google na sede dos Estados Unidos custou R$ 90 mil aos cofres públicos, segundo apurou a

Pública

. 


Um dos projetos de lei, que terminou por beneficiar o Google, foi protocolado pelo Executivo do Estado na Assembleia Legislativa no dia seguinte à reunião com executivos da empresa. E virou lei seis dias depois. 


Desde então, o Google se instalou de forma inédita na administração estadual e

não esconde o interesse

 em abrir data centers à base de biometano [combustível renovável obtido a partir do biogás] na região. Observar a cronologia da tramitação ajuda a entender o que está em jogo.


Por que isso importa?


Investigação mostra como Goiás se abriu às Big Techs, com o poder de decisão concentrado nas mãos do ex-governador e atual candidato à Presidência, Ronaldo Caiado.

Protocolada um dia depois de Caiado se reunir com o Google em Nova York, a lei de fomento à inteligência artificial de Goiás foi aprovada em menos de 48 horas, sem debate. Meses depois, em ritmo igualmente relâmpago, veio a lei dos minerais críticos, que facilita a exploração de terras raras.


Segunda-feira, 12 de maio de 2025


Número 550 da Washington Street, um dos endereços do Google em Nova York. Era o primeiro compromisso da agenda oficial de Caiado nos Estados Unidos. Ele entrou no escritório da empresa acompanhado de quatro auxiliares: o secretário-geral de Governo, Adriano da Rocha Lima; o subsecretário de Tecnologia da Informação, Márcio Cesar Pereira; o superintendente de Administração de Dados e Inteligência Analítica, Alaor José da Silva; e o diretor-executivo do Instituto Mauro Borges, órgão de estatística e estudos do estado, Erik Alencar Figueiredo.


A reunião não deixou registros formais: não houve ata, memorando ou lista de presença. A imprensa do governo divulgou apenas uma

nota

 dizendo que “o diálogo com executivos da gigante de tecnologia teve como foco a construção de parcerias voltadas para inovação e inteligência artificial, com o objetivo de modernizar e aprimorar a gestão pública em seu estado”.


“Procurei no Google por: ‘melhor início de agenda em NY’ – e cheguei nestas imagens”, postou Ronaldo Caiado no Instagram


Ainda no dia 12, Lima gravou um vídeo para o Instagram da Secretaria-Geral de Governo de Goiás. “Nós acabamos de enviar para a Assembleia Legislativa o nosso marco legal da inteligência artificial, que se contrapõe totalmente àquilo que foi apresentado no Congresso Nacional, dando realmente a importância que a inteligência artificial tem no desenvolvimento da nossa sociedade”, disse.


Terça-feira, 13 de maio


No dia seguinte à visita ao Google, o

projeto de lei

 elaborado pelo governo estadual foi protocolado na Assembleia Legislativa de Goiás às 10h40, enquanto a comitiva ainda estava nos Estados Unidos. Às 15h48 do mesmo dia, o texto foi lido no plenário.


Menos de uma hora depois, entre 16h27 e 16h49, o projeto passou pela chamada Comissão Mista. Com o recurso, em vez de percorrer as comissões temáticas que normalmente analisam um projeto, a proposta foi levada a uma única “supercomissão”, que cumpre a função de todas de uma vez, o que acelera a tramitação. Nesses 22 minutos, o

texto

 de 29 páginas foi lido, analisado e recebeu um parecer favorável de cinco páginas de fundamentação jurídica.


A primeira votação em plenário aconteceu no mesmo dia e durou apenas oito minutos – das 17h29 às 17h37. Havia 24 parlamentares presentes e, assim que 21 votos foram registrados (que representam maioria absoluta), a votação foi encerrada. Nas

imagens da sessão

, não há registro de discussões sobre o conteúdo da proposta.


Antes do projeto enviado pelo governo, os deputados Talles Barreto (União Brasil) …

author: Redação
title: Microbolsas Big Techs
content:
A 21ª edição das 

microbolsas

 da

Agência Pública

 selecionou três reportagens investigativas sobre lobby, contratos e alianças políticas das Big Techs nos estados e municípios brasileiros.


Os estados mantêm contratos próprios com as Big Techs, o que, em alguns casos, pode representar conflitos de interesse. As reportagens exploram como o lobby dessas empresas tem moldado a legislação brasileira por meio de disputas no Congresso, onde conseguiram barrar projetos de lei, como o

PL das Fake News

, que buscava ampliar a transparência e responsabilizar as plataformas pelo conteúdo que publicam.

title: Prof. Dr. Adaman: Structural problems need addressed, for seasonal workers problems to end
content:
Nearly one million seasonal agricultural workers in Turkey move from city to city and from field to field in an effort to make a living. Workers who bear the heaviest burden of agricultural production face problems including insecure and low-paid employment, inadequate housing conditions, lack of access to clean water and healthcare, child labour and deprivation of the right to education. Extreme heat and severe weather events caused by the climate crisis are making their working and living conditions increasingly difficult each year, while Kurdish seasonal agricultural workers also face racism. Despite circulars, projects and parliamentary motions addressing the problems of seasonal workers, the situation on the ground remains unchanged.


Research points out that Kurds make up a significant proportion of seasonal agricultural workers and that economic exploitation is intertwined with ethnic discrimination. The Research Report on Seasonal Migrant Agricultural Labour prepared by Pınar Uyan Semerci, Emre Erdoğan and Sinem Kavak also states that Kurdish workers face discrimination in the regions where they travel for work. The report highlights concrete examples of ethnic discrimination, particularly wage discrimination and social exclusion.


According to research, 80 percent of families live in tents, more than half have no access to electricity, and almost all workers work more than nine hours a day. Children account for 52 percent of the population living in the households covered by the research.


Boğaziçi University Department of Economics faculty member and economist Prof. Dr. Fikret Adaman spoke to ANF about the problems faced by seasonal agricultural workers.


Prof. Adaman pointed out that seasonal agricultural workers are people who work temporarily during the planting, cultivation and harvesting periods of agricultural products, and that a significant proportion of them are forced to migrate between different cities for much of the year in order to make a living. He said: “Although migration may involve individuals moving on their own, generally the entire family participates in this process. It is observed that the vast majority of seasonal migrant workers, who are known to face great difficulties in accessing basic rights such as housing, education and healthcare, live below the poverty line and generally have limited access to social security.”


Noting that a significant proportion of seasonal workers, mostly together with their families, spend four to five months of the year in fields, tent settlements or inadequate shelters, Adaman continued: “On the other hand, there are also people who do seasonal agricultural work and have to migrate because they do not have sufficient means of subsistence where they live. For most seasonal workers, extreme heat and inadequate hygiene make life difficult. For example, it is known that the prevalence of maternal and infant deaths during childbirth is far above the Turkish average.


Rising temperatures and extreme weather events such as hail and torrential rain brought about by the climate crisis further worsen the situation of seasonal workers. In addition to the adverse conditions in which they work and live, families who migrate with their children face additional problems.


Whether because educational opportunities are limited or because, in many cases, workers are paid according to output rather than a daily wage, for example, based on the amount of produce collected during the day, children under the legal working age of 15 are also forced to work in the fields. This not only exposes children’s bodies to harsh conditions, but perhaps more importantly, causes missed schooling to turn into a permanent loss of education.”


Economist Adaman also noted: “Because of the difficulties agriculture is experiencing throughout Turkey, the hardships faced by this group — people who are, so to speak, half-proletarianised and half farmers, alongside those who spend only four or five months of the year moving from field to field, mostly living in tents, in order to sell their labour — are being addressed extensively both in academic studies and in the media.”


Almost a million seasonal agricultural workers are living a nomadic life
